papers.title: Signatures of the Quantum Geometric Dipole of Interlayer Excitons in Counterflow Conductivity
papers.abstract: Collective excitations of many-body electron systems can carry internal structure, supporting novel quantum geometric and topological properties. Among these are a quantum geometric dipole (QGD), which for excitons have direct significance as an internal polarization. For interlayer excitons of a bilayer system, this represents an in-plane dipole moment, which can be used to drive them with in-plane electric fields. In this work, we consider counterflow electric currents associated with driven excitons in such a bilayer system as a probe of their QGD structure. As a simple but non-trivial example, we analyze a structure with a one-dimensional periodic potential in a strong perpendicular magnetic field. The resulting magnetoexciton bands host QGD structure that distinguishes it from the exciton QGD of a uniform system. To model exciton transport we adopt a Boltzmann approach that includes inter-band tunneling, allowing us to consider non-equilibrium momentum distributions that result from strong layer-antisymmetric driving fields. We show how linear response to a layer-symmetric component of the driving fields provide information about the QGD, and that the broad QGD structure of the exciton bands can be probed by the varying the layer-antisymmetric field. Our results demonstrate that counterflow conductivity serves as a tunable probe of the internal quantum geometric structure carried by the interlayer excitons, connecting transport to the quantum geometry of many-body excitations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“采用玻尔兹曼方法”“分析结构”“展示响应”等理论建模与计算分析关键词，未涉及实验数据或样品制备。；研究对象：双层体系中层间激子的量子几何偶极矩（QGD），以及与之相关的反向流动电导率（counterflow conductivity）。具体体系为在强垂直磁场下具有一维周期势的结构，形成磁激子能带。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反向流动电导率可作为探测层间激子内禀量子几何偶极结构的可调探针，通过改变层反对称驱动场可以探测激子能带的宽QGD结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反向流动电导率可作为探测层间激子内禀量子几何偶极结构的可调探针，通过改变层反对称驱动场可以探测激子能带的宽QGD结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比，但明确指出该工作首次将反向流动电导率与层间激子的量子几何偶极结构联系起来，并展示了通过驱动场调控来探测该结构的方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用玻尔兹曼输运方法，包含能带间隧穿效应，用于建模由强层反对称驱动场导致的非平衡动量分布；通过线性响应分析层对称驱动场分量对QGD的响应。

papers.title: Hollow Needle Puncture Mechanics for Biopsy Sampling
papers.abstract: Biopsy sampling relies on hollow needles that puncture soft tissues by propagating and opening a cylindrical crack, yet the mechanics governing this coring process remain only partially understood. Motivated by this gap, we develop a simple, energy based model for puncture by blunt hollow needles, grounded in brittle fracture mechanics and extended to include frictional interactions at the needle tissue interface. The model describes puncture as the competition between the fracture energy and the elastic energy. This energetic balance is controlled by the interplay among needle geometry (radius and wall thickness), material properties (toughness and elastic modulus), and interfacial parameters (adhesion and friction). This model provides semi analytical predictions for five key quantities, core size, frictionless force, frictional force slope, critical insertion depth, and critical insertion force. Model predictions are validated against experiments, demonstrating that friction significantly improves force estimation and alters the puncture regime. These results offer quantitative insight into the mechanics of tissue coring and force generation during biopsy, providing a predictive foundation for needle design, sampling performance, and real time control in robotic biopsy and needle insertion systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a simple, energy based model”（发展了一个基于能量的简单模型），并“validated against experiments”（通过实验验证），属于理论建模与实验验证相结合的混合类型。；研究对象：论文研究的具体物理现象是：空心针穿刺软组织进行活检取样时的力学机制，特别是圆柱形裂纹的扩展与组织芯的切割过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 穿刺过程是断裂能与弹性能之间的竞争，该竞争由针的几何形状、材料韧性和弹性模量以及界面摩擦共同控制。摩擦显著改善了力的预测精度并改变了穿刺模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：穿刺过程是断裂能与弹性能之间的竞争，该竞争由针的几何形状、材料韧性和弹性模量以及界面摩擦共同控制。摩擦显著改善了力的预测精度并改变了穿刺模式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的明确创新点，但指出已有研究对“coring process”（取芯过程）的力学机制理解不完整，本文填补了这一空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于脆性断裂力学，建立了一个能量模型，并扩展引入了针-组织界面的摩擦相互作用。模型提供了五个关键量的半解析预测：芯尺寸、无摩擦穿刺力、摩擦力斜率、临界插入深度和临界插入力。

papers.title: Atomic scale demonstration of ferromagnetism in a single layer FeCl2 on Au(111)
papers.abstract: FeCl2 is a promising single-layer material with sizeable magnetic susceptibility and insulating character that can be easily grown by molecular beam epitaxy on various surfaces. In order to include it into the select palette of van der Waals materials used to engineer functional heterostructures, it is necessary to confirm its magnetic and electronic ground states, and understand the influence of the supporting substrate. In this work, we unambiguously demonstrate ferromagnetic ordering in a single-layer FeCl2 on Au(111) by means of spin-polarized scanning tunnelling microscopy. The material features a relatively wide insulating gap of 3.3 eV and a strongly spin-polarized conduction band that emerges at 1.5 eV above the Fermi level. Atomic scale defects with triangular shape play a primary role in the electronic gap and spin density distribution. Specifically, in a region of 1.6 nm around each defect, the conduction band is locally suppressed and the tunnelling magneto-conductance is reduced a factor of four. By tracking the spin-dependent tunnelling conductance as a function of the applied magnetic field, we record atomically resolved hysteresis loops, revealing a soft ferromagnetic ground state with pronounced out-of-plane anisotropy and coercive fields in the range of 15-50 mT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：spin-polarized scanning tunnelling microscopy（自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜）、分子束外延生长、磁导测量等实验手段。；研究对象：单层FeCl₂薄膜在Au(111)衬底上的铁磁有序及其电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 明确证实了单层FeCl₂在Au(111)上具有铁磁有序，表现为软铁磁基态、显著的面外各向异性，以及15-50 mT的矫顽场；同时发现原子尺度的三角形缺陷会局域抑制导带并降低隧穿磁导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：明确证实了单层FeCl₂在Au(111)上具有铁磁有序，表现为软铁磁基态、显著的面外各向异性，以及15-50 mT的矫顽场；同时发现原子尺度的三角形缺陷会局域抑制导带并降低隧穿磁导。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上直接演示了单层FeCl₂在Au(111)上的铁磁有序，并揭示了三角形缺陷对电子能隙和自旋密度分布的显著影响。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长单层FeCl₂薄膜；自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜（SP-STM）用于磁结构成像；隧穿磁导随外加磁场的测量用于记录原子分辨的磁滞回线。

papers.title: Spin Glass Mapping of the Parallel Minority Game
papers.abstract: The parallel minority game (PMG) extends the classical minority game to many choices, with each agent restricted to two predetermined alternatives. In this condition, minimizing the population variance across all choices is a complex combinatorial optimization problem. We show that this minimization is exactly equivalent to finding the ground state of an Ising spin glass in the mean-field limit, i.e., the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model. By encoding the agent choices as spin variables, the variance becomes a quadratic Hamiltonian with quenched random couplings $J_{ij}$ and random fields $h_i$. This mapping reveals inherent frustration and connects the PMG to the well developed theory of spin glasses, providing a new perspective on the frozen, sub-optimal configurations observed in stochastic strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mapping（映射）、spin glass（自旋玻璃）、mean-field limit（平均场极限）。；研究对象：平行少数者博弈（Parallel Minority Game, PMG）这一多智能体博弈系统，具体研究其最小化所有选择人口方差这一组合优化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平行少数者博弈中最小化人口方差的问题，在平均场极限下等价于寻找伊辛自旋玻璃（Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型）的基态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平行少数者博弈中最小化人口方差的问题，在平均场极限下等价于寻找伊辛自旋玻璃（Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型）的基态。；创新点：首次将平行少数者博弈中的复杂组合优化问题精确映射到平均场自旋玻璃模型，揭示了该博弈中固有的阻挫特性，并利用自旋玻璃的成熟理论为随机策略中出现的冻结、次优构型提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 通过将智能体的选择编码为自旋变量，将人口方差映射为具有淬火随机耦合 \(J_{ij}\) 和随机场 \(h_i\) 的二次哈密顿量，从而建立与自旋玻璃理论的严格对应关系。

papers.title: Topological cell-openness index for porous materials
papers.abstract: We propose a method of estimating the proportion of open and closed cells in a porous material based on measuring Betti numbers on the structures. Based on this method, we define a cell-openness index τ which can be used instead of or complementary to the proportion of open-celled volume reported by gas pycnometry, which is the current gold standard for pore type characterization. We discuss in what types of structures mismatches between the two measures can occur and how such mismatches convey additional information about the structure. We also demonstrate initial examples of significant correlations between τ and measurable physical quantities in numerically generated structures. We also discuss how Betti curves can be used to estimate characteristic feature sizes in porous structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：提出方法（propose a method）、基于数值生成结构（numerically generated structures）、讨论Betti数测量（measuring Betti numbers）。；研究对象：多孔材料（porous materials）中开孔与闭孔的占比及其拓扑表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于Betti数测量的拓扑开孔指数τ，可替代或补充气体比重法（gas pycnometry）作为孔类型表征的新指标；τ与可测量物理量之间存在显著相关性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于Betti数测量的拓扑开孔指数τ，可替代或补充气体比重法（gas pycnometry）作为孔类型表征的新指标；τ与可测量物理量之间存在显著相关性。；创新点：首次将拓扑学中的Betti数引入多孔材料开孔/闭孔比例的定量表征，并指出该指标与气体比重法结果可能出现的差异可提供额外结构信息。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算多孔结构的Betti数来估计开孔与闭孔比例，定义拓扑开孔指数τ；利用Betti曲线估计多孔结构中的特征尺寸。

papers.title: Signatures of quantum chaos in phonon-polariton billiards
papers.abstract: We use scanning near-field optical microscopy to image hyperbolic phonon polaritons in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) billiards with integrable and chaotic geometries. In Sinai billiards, we observe irregular mode patterns consistent with quantum scarring, together with an unexpected sensitivity to weak probe perturbations. These random-wave features coexist with non-chaotic one-dimensional boundary modes arising from nontrivial polariton reflection at the billiard edge. As the billiard boundary becomes increasingly complex, the Fourier transforms of the measured signals evolve toward ring-like structures consistent with Berry's random-wave conjecture. We develop a numerical framework based on the Helmholtz equation with generalized boundary conditions that encode angle-dependent reflection phase shifts. The calculated level statistics exhibit a crossover from Poisson-like behavior in integrable billiards to Wigner-Dyson-like behavior in chaotic geometries, with small deviations from the canonical form arising from nonlinear boundary conditions that require self-consistent bulk-boundary analysis. Theoretical analysis based on dissipative Green's functions qualitatively reproduces the near-field data. These results establish mesoscopic van der Waals billiards as a rich platform for studying generalized chaotic dynamics of hybrid light-matter polaritons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论计算）。判断依据：使用扫描近场光学显微镜进行成像（实验），并发展了基于亥姆霍兹方程和广义边界条件的数值框架（理论计算）。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的双曲声子极化激元，具体研究其在可积和混沌几何形状的“台球”（billiard）中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在混沌几何（Sinai台球）中观察到与量子疤痕一致的不规则模式，以及对外界弱探针扰动的意外敏感性。随着边界复杂化，测量信号的傅里叶变换演变为与Berry随机波猜想一致的环状结构。能级统计从可积台球的泊松分布交叉到混沌几何的Wigner-Dyson分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在混沌几何（Sinai台球）中观察到与量子疤痕一致的不规则模式，以及对外界弱探针扰动的意外敏感性。随着边界复杂化，测量信号的傅里叶变换演变为与Berry随机波猜想一致的环状结构。能级统计从可积台球的泊松分布交叉到混沌几何的Wigner-Dyson分布。；创新点：建立了介观范德华台球系统作为研究光-物质混合极化激元广义混沌动力学的新平台。摘要未突出说明与之前具体哪项工作相比的创新点，但核心在于将量子混沌的概念（如量子疤痕、随机波猜想）首次应用于声子极化激元体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用扫描近场光学显微镜（SNOM）直接成像。理论上，基于带有广义边界条件（编码角度依赖的反射相位偏移）的亥姆霍兹方程建立数值框架，并利用耗散格林函数进行理论分析。

papers.title: Monitored quantum transport through a disordered one-dimensional conductor
papers.abstract: We formulate a quantum master equation for the many-particle density matrix of electrons propagating through a single-mode conductor, combining elastic scattering by disorder with time-resolved projective measurements that monitor the outcome of scattering events. The full counting statistics of transmitted electrons has a binomial distribution function, whose mean ${\cal T}$ and variance ${\cal T}(1-{\cal T})$ determine the conductance and shot noise power, respectively. Monitoring suppresses the phase coherence responsible for one-dimensional localization: The decay with conductor length $L$ of the typical transmission probability crosses over at $L\simeq \ell_φ$ from the exponential $e^{-L/ξ}$ (with localization length $ξ$) to the Ohmic $1/L$ decay. Numerical solution of the master equation gives, for weak monitoring, a logarithmic dependence $\ell_φ\simeq ξ\ln(v_{\rm F}τ_φ/ξ)$ of the coherence length $\ell_φ$ on the mean time $τ_φ$ between measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：量子主方程、理论框架、数值求解。；研究对象：通过无序一维导体的量子输运过程，具体为单模导体中电子在无序散射与时间分辨投影测量共同作用下的多粒子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 监测（测量）会抑制导致一维局域化的相位相干性，使典型透射概率随导体长度L的衰减从指数衰减（e^{-L/ξ}）在L≈ℓ_φ处交叉为欧姆型衰减（1/L）。在弱监测下，相干长度ℓ_φ与测量间隔时间τ_φ呈对数关系：ℓ_φ≈ξ ln(v_F τ_φ/ξ)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：监测（测量）会抑制导致一维局域化的相位相干性，使典型透射概率随导体长度L的衰减从指数衰减（e^{-L/ξ}）在L≈ℓ_φ处交叉为欧姆型衰减（1/L）。在弱监测下，相干长度ℓ_φ与测量间隔时间τ_φ呈对数关系：ℓ_φ≈ξ ln(v_F τ_φ/ξ)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建了描述电子通过单模导体传播的多粒子密度矩阵的量子主方程，结合无序弹性散射与时间分辨投影测量，并通过数值求解主方程获得结果。

papers.title: Directed extended-range percolation
papers.abstract: While for standard percolation directionality is known to increase the combinatorial complexity of percolation, here we show that when connectivity is ensured by paths of length $R\geq 2$, network directionality, impeding backtracking, can significantly reduce the complexity of percolation. To illustrate this finding, we introduce Directed Extended-Range Percolation (DERP), defined directed networks with non-reciprocal edges, motivated by applications in quantum communication. In this framework, message transmission is enabled between trusted nodes separated by a directed path of length at most $R$. Using a message-passing approach, we show that directionality enables an exact determination of the percolation threshold and the anomalous critical indices on locally tree-like structures. On random directed networks we find that the critical behavior of DERP depends sensitively on degree correlations. These analytical predictions are corroborated by extensive Monte Carlo simulations, highlighting the profound impact of directionality and correlations on long-range connectivity in complex networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：引入新模型（DERP）、使用消息传递方法进行理论分析、结合蒙特卡洛模拟验证。；研究对象：有向网络中的扩展范围渗流（Directed Extended-Range Percolation, DERP），即节点间通过长度不超过R的有向路径实现连通性的渗流问题，应用背景为量子通信中的可信节点间消息传输。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当连通性由长度R≥2的路径保证时，网络的方向性（阻止回溯）可显著降低渗流的复杂性，使得在局部树状结构上能精确确定渗流阈值和反常临界指数；在随机有向网络中，临界行为对度关联敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当连通性由长度R≥2的路径保证时，网络的方向性（阻止回溯）可显著降低渗流的复杂性，使得在局部树状结构上能精确确定渗流阈值和反常临界指数；在随机有向网络中，临界行为对度关联敏感。；创新点：首次系统研究方向性对扩展范围渗流（R≥2）的影响，发现方向性可简化而非增加渗流复杂性，并揭示了度关联对临界行为的敏感调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 消息传递方法（message-passing approach）进行理论分析，结合大规模蒙特卡洛模拟验证理论预测。

papers.title: A Local Probe Mass Spectrometer for Localized and Sensitive Product Detection in Environmental Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: Aberration-corrected environmental transmission electron microscopy (ETEM) enables atomic-resolution imaging of dynamic catalytic processes. Correlating atomic-scale structural changes with reaction products detected by mass spectrometry offers a powerful route to uncover catalytic mechanisms. However, current approaches face fundamental limitations: closed-cell ETEM setups suffer from diffuse scattering by SiN windows, degrading spatial resolution and sensitivity, while open-cell configurations enable high-resolution imaging and maintain high sensitivity but suffer from significant dilution of reaction products during transport to the mass spectrometer (MS). To overcome these challenges, we develop a Local Probe Mass Spectrometer (LPMS) integrated with aberration-corrected ETEM. The setup combines a DENSsolution Stream holder with a MS. To preserve spatial resolution, both top and bottom SiN membranes of the MEMS chip are removed, while the gas environment is maintained via the ETEM chamber. Reaction products are sampled locally via a micro-capillary positioned near the catalyst and connected to a holder gas line that delivers the gas to the MS. Initial validation in environmental SEM confirmed controlled gas delivery to the MS. Co3O4 nanoplates serve as a model catalyst due to their inherent electron transparency, enabling atomic-resolution imaging without FIB lamella preparation and associated ion-beam damage. A novel micro-shuttle transfer strategy enables controlled placement of a defined number of nanoplates at the reaction site with precise crystallographic orientation. This establishes the foundation for quantitative structure reactivity correlation by enabling simultaneous, spatially resolved detection of reaction products and atomic-scale structural dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验装置搭建（Local Probe Mass Spectrometer）、样品制备（Co3O4 nanoplates）及验证过程（initial validation in environmental SEM）。；研究对象：环境透射电子显微镜（ETEM）中催化反应的原位观测体系，具体以Co3O4纳米片为模型催化剂，研究其原子尺度结构变化与反应产物之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集成局部探针质谱仪（LPMS）与像差校正ETEM，实现了在保持高空间分辨率的同时，对反应产物进行局部、灵敏的检测，为建立定量结构-反应性关联奠定了基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集成局部探针质谱仪（LPMS）与像差校正ETEM，实现了在保持高空间分辨率的同时，对反应产物进行局部、灵敏的检测，为建立定量结构-反应性关联奠定了基础。；创新点：1）首次在开放式ETEM构型中实现局部、灵敏的反应产物质谱检测，克服了传统闭式构型中SiN窗口导致的空间分辨率下降和开放式构型中产物稀释的问题；2）开发了微穿梭转移策略，实现了对催化剂纳米片数量及晶体学取向的精确控制。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：1）将DENSsolution Stream样品杆与质谱仪（MS）集成；2）移除MEMS芯片的上下SiN窗口以保持空间分辨率，利用ETEM腔体维持气体环境；3）通过靠近催化剂的微毛细管局部采样反应产物，经样品杆气体管线输送至MS；4）采用微穿梭转移策略（micro-shuttle transfer）精确放置特定数量的Co3O4纳米片。

papers.title: Spintronic Neuromorphic Hardware Using Domain Wall Based Neurons and Quantized Synapses
papers.abstract: In this work, we simulate the functionality of artificial neuron and synapse using spin-orbit torque-based spintronic devices and implemented a fully connected artificial neural netwrok (ANN). These neuro-synaptic devices are emulated using transverse domain wall dynamics in a rectangular magnetic nanotrack comprised of heavy metal/ferromagnet (HM/FM) heterostructures. The ReLU activation function of the neuron has been mimicked using the domain wall motion induced by a 3 ns current pulse. The synapse has been modelled using current-induced domain wall (DW) dynamics through a corrugated HM/FM nanotrack under the influence of a 10 ns current pulse with varying current density. The semicircular corrugations are in the form of notches, which are symmetrically located on both sides of the nanotrack. By applying 10 ns current pulses of varying densities, we achieve controlled DW pinning, revealing a step-like motion caused by temporary pauses at each pinning center. The electrical conductance of the pinned DW across various pinning points, act as stable synaptic weights for our ANN. Furthermore, we observe a threshold-dependent delay effect where each depinning event is influenced by previous ones, successfully mimicking synaptic memory and adaptability in neuromorphic systems. The fully connected ANN has been modeled using the conventional float32 synaptic weights for the MNIST and Fashion MNIST datasets with an accuracy of ~97 % and ~86 %, respectively, which serves as a test bed of our neuromorphic simulations. With the aim of implementing a sparse and low memory footprint ANN, we quantize the trained synaptic weights into discrete quantized level and tested the network, which demonstrate an accuracy of ~95% and ~62%, for the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST dataset, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“simulate the functionality”、“emulated using”、“modelled using”、“modeled using”等关键词，主要基于数值模拟和仿真，未提及实验制备或测量。；研究对象：基于自旋轨道矩（SOT）的自旋电子器件，具体为重金属/铁磁（HM/FM）异质结中的横向磁畴壁动力学，用于构建人工神经元和突触，并实现全连接人工神经网络（ANN）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用3 ns电流脉冲驱动磁畴壁运动模拟了神经元的ReLU激活函数；通过10 ns不同密度电流脉冲在带有半圆形凹槽的纳米轨道中实现可控的磁畴壁钉扎，获得阶梯状运动，并将不同钉扎点的电导作为稳定的突触权重。对MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集，全连接ANN在float32权重下分别达到约97%和86%的准确率；将权重量化后，准确率分别降至约95%和62%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用3 ns电流脉冲驱动磁畴壁运动模拟了神经元的ReLU激活函数；通过10 ns不同密度电流脉冲在带有半圆形凹槽的纳米轨道中实现可控的磁畴壁钉扎，获得阶梯状运动，并将不同钉扎点的电导作为稳定的突触权重。对MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集，全连接ANN在float32权重下分别达到约97%和86%的准确率；将权重量化后，准确率分别降至约95%和62%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于磁畴壁动力学的数值模拟，具体包括：在矩形磁性纳米轨道（HM/FM异质结）中模拟横向磁畴壁运动；通过3 ns电流脉冲实现神经元ReLU激活函数；通过10 ns不同密度电流脉冲在带有对称半圆形凹槽的纳米轨道中模拟突触权重；使用常规float32权重和量化权重训练全连接ANN，并在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上测试。

papers.title: Nonlinear Magnon Magnetic Moment Transport in Triangular-Lattice f-Wave Antialtermagnets
papers.abstract: We study the spin excitations in the frustrated coplanar 120-degree ground state of the triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet and demonstrate that they carry a magnetic moment perpendicular to the plane in which the spins order, despite the ground-state sublattice moments having no out-of-plane component. The symmetry of the momentum dependence of the magnetic moment and energy of the magnons renders the system an odd-parity f-wave magnet. Extending this model to a stack of antiferromagnetically coupled triangular layers provides a realization of magnons in a three-dimensional f-wave antialtermagnet. We show that nonlinear thermal transport effects of magnons, such as Edelstein and spin-splitter effects, provide clear experimental signatures of magnons in f-wave antialtermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We study”“We show”“provides a realization”等表述，未提及实验数据或计算模拟，主要基于模型分析和理论推导。；研究对象：三角晶格海森堡反铁磁体中的自旋激发（磁振子），特别是其在受挫共面120度基态下的磁矩输运行为，以及由此构建的三维f波反交变磁体中的磁振子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三角晶格反铁磁体的共面120度基态中，磁振子携带垂直于自旋有序平面的磁矩，尽管基态子晶格磁矩无面外分量；该磁振子的磁矩与能量随动量的对称性使系统成为奇宇称f波磁体。在三维堆叠结构中，磁振子的非线性热输运效应（如Edelstein效应和自旋劈裂效应）可作为f波反交变磁体中磁振子的清晰实验特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三角晶格反铁磁体的共面120度基态中，磁振子携带垂直于自旋有序平面的磁矩，尽管基态子晶格磁矩无面外分量；该磁振子的磁矩与能量随动量的对称性使系统成为奇宇称f波磁体。在三维堆叠结构中，磁振子的非线性热输运效应（如Edelstein效应和自旋劈裂效应）可作为f波反交变磁体中磁振子的清晰实验特征。；创新点：首次提出在三角晶格反铁磁体的共面120度基态中，磁振子可携带面外磁矩并具有f波对称性，从而将反交变磁体概念拓展至磁振子体系，并指出非线性热输运效应可作为其实验探测手段。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型分析：基于受挫三角晶格海森堡反铁磁体的共面120度基态，研究自旋激发的磁矩对称性；通过反铁磁耦合的三角层堆叠扩展至三维f波反交变磁体模型，并分析磁振子的非线性热输运效应。

papers.title: Upscaling DFT-trained machine-learning interatomic potential toward Quantum Monte Carlo accuracy: Sulfur-vacancy migration in monolayer MoS$_2$ as a testbed
papers.abstract: We designed a procedure to train a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) at benchmark-quality quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) accuracy. To avoid the complexities of high-quality atomic force determination with the stochastic QMC methods, we use a multi-fidelity approach wherein high-level QMC energies are used alongside suitably processed low-level DFT atomic forces to train a QMC fine-tuned MLIP which significantly improves both the energetics and atomic forces over the baseline DFT-based MLIP. Fine-tuning is only applied to the readout layers of an equivariant message-passing MACE MLIP. We used sulfur mono- and multiple vacancies in monolayer MoS$_2$ as a testbed and demonstrate a near QMC accuracy of the model in a number of in- and out-of-domain tests. We show that a fairly limited dataset of QMC energies suffice to significantly improve the baseline DFT MLIP. The accuracy of our approach is demonstrated on energy and free energy migration barriers of mono- and multiple S-vacancy defects. The results open the window to large-scale near QMC quality simulations with large numbers of atoms and/or molecular dynamics configurations which would not be possible by a direct brute-force application of QMC methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP)、DFT、Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC)、multi-fidelity approach。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（monolayer MoS₂）中的硫空位（sulfur mono- and multiple vacancies）及其迁移行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多保真度方法，利用少量高精度量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）能量数据对基于DFT的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行微调，可使其在能量和原子力上接近QMC精度，并成功用于计算单空位和多空位的能量及自由能迁移势垒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多保真度方法，利用少量高精度量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）能量数据对基于DFT的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行微调，可使其在能量和原子力上接近QMC精度，并成功用于计算单空位和多空位的能量及自由能迁移势垒。；创新点：提出了一种将DFT训练的MLIP升级至接近QMC精度的实用流程，仅需有限数量的QMC能量数据即可显著提升模型性能，从而使得大规模原子模拟（如大体系或分子动力学）能够达到接近QMC的精度，而这是直接暴力应用QMC方法无法实现的。
papers.method_zh: 采用多保真度训练策略：以高精度QMC能量作为目标，结合经适当处理的低精度DFT原子力，对等变消息传递神经网络（MACE MLIP）的读出层进行微调（fine-tuning）。测试包括域内和域外验证，并计算了缺陷迁移的势垒。

papers.title: Quantum Batteries in two-dimensional material-based Josephson Junctions
papers.abstract: We investigate the solid-state implementation of a Dicke-like quantum battery consisting of a two-dimensional material-based Josephson junction inductively coupled to a resonator, using graphene as a representative example. In this configuration, Andreev bound states naturally act as non-interacting, energetically non-degenerate two-level systems, and the setup allows for both single-photon and two-photon resonant processes. The coupling between the LC-circuit flux and the supercurrent through the junction gives rise to peculiar longitudinal interaction terms that have no counterpart in the conventional Dicke model. These additional couplings can enhance energy storage for a proper range of parameters. The proposed architecture also enables an alternative, but equivalent, charging protocol that relies on tuning the superconducting phase difference across the junction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate（理论研究）、proposed architecture（提出架构）、charging protocol（充电协议）。；研究对象：基于二维材料（以石墨烯为代表）的约瑟夫森结，作为Dicke型量子电池的固态实现方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该量子电池结构中，安德烈夫束缚态天然充当非相互作用、非简并的两能级系统，且LC电路磁通与结中超电流的耦合产生了传统Dicke模型中没有的纵向相互作用项，这些额外耦合可在适当参数范围内增强能量存储。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该量子电池结构中，安德烈夫束缚态天然充当非相互作用、非简并的两能级系统，且LC电路磁通与结中超电流的耦合产生了传统Dicke模型中没有的纵向相互作用项，这些额外耦合可在适当参数范围内增强能量存储。；创新点：提出了基于二维材料约瑟夫森结的固态量子电池架构，发现了不同于传统Dicke模型的纵向耦合项，并展示了通过调节超导相位差实现替代充电协议的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：构建了包含二维材料约瑟夫森结与谐振器电感耦合的量子电池模型，分析了单光子和双光子共振过程，并研究了通过调节结上超导相位差实现等效充电协议的可行性。

papers.title: Entanglement Dynamics across a Monitored Quantum Point Contact
papers.abstract: We compute the entanglement dynamics across a monitored quantum point contact, where particle losses are recorded on a given site, and demonstrate how this single-site local monitoring substantially reshapes the entanglement production. Contrary to the unitary case, where entanglement entropy grows logarithmically in time, here we find first a linear growth, up to a maximum value displaying volume-law scaling, and then a slow decay to zero, as the system empties out. We capture this crossover using a quasiparticle picture, where the first linear growth arises due to an emergent bias voltage established by the losses, which eventually decays away as the system depletes. We connect our results to studies of the Page curve and to experimentally relevant probes, via full counting statistics of charge transfer across a subregion, with only a single channel to unravel leading to a favorable scaling of the postselection overhead. Natural platforms for this setting include mesoscopic systems and ultracold atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“计算”（compute）、“准粒子图像”（quasiparticle picture）等理论分析词汇，未提及具体实验操作或数据。；研究对象：受监测的量子点接触（monitored quantum point contact）中的纠缠动力学。具体物理现象是：在单个位点记录粒子损失（即进行局域监测）的情况下，通过该点接触的纠缠熵随时间演化的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 与无监测（幺正）情况下纠缠熵随时间对数增长不同，局域监测导致纠缠熵先线性增长至一个呈现体积律标度的最大值，随后随着系统排空而缓慢衰减至零。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：与无监测（幺正）情况下纠缠熵随时间对数增长不同，局域监测导致纠缠熵先线性增长至一个呈现体积律标度的最大值，随后随着系统排空而缓慢衰减至零。；创新点：揭示了单个位点的局域监测如何从根本上改变量子点接触中的纠缠产生模式，并发现了从线性增长（由损耗建立的偏压驱动）到缓慢衰减（系统耗尽）的交叉行为。摘要未突出说明与以往监测量子点接触研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与分析。具体包括：计算了受监测量子点接触的纠缠动力学；利用准粒子图像（quasiparticle picture）解释了从线性增长到衰减的交叉行为；将结果与Page曲线研究及全计数统计（full counting statistics）联系起来，并讨论了后选择开销（postselection overhead）的标度。

papers.title: Competing incommensurability, electronic correlations, and superconductivity in a hybrid transition metal dichalcogenide
papers.abstract: The engineering of superlattices in two-dimensional van der Waals materials has enabled the realization of rich phase diagrams hosting topological and strongly correlated phases. While incommensurability is widespread in three-dimensional systems, the role of moiré potentials in bulk materials remains largely unexplored. Here, using scanning tunneling microscopy, we demonstrate that a bulk transition-metal dichalcogenide polytype, 4Hb-TaS$_2$, hosts an emergent incommensurate potential between its alternating 1T and 1H layers. Interplay with a concomitant incommensurate charge-density wave suppresses the long-range order of this potential, leading to intricate coupling with electronic correlations in the doped 1T surface layer. Combining density functional theory with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that the lattice mismatch locally modulates the interlayer distance, thereby tuning both hybridization and charge transfer between the correlated 1T and metallic 1H layers. This redistribution of charge drives the system towards a doped Mott regime, in which the remaining local moments become self-screened, giving rise to a zero-bias resonance. We further find that bulk superconductivity competes with both the underlying landscape and the associated charge transfer. Our results establish incommensurate potentials as a previously overlooked ingredient in hybrid transition-metal dichalcogenides, highlighting their central role in the interplay between electronic correlations, charge-density-wave order, and unconventional superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实验手段，以及密度泛函理论（DFT）结合动力学平均场理论（DMFT）的计算方法。；研究对象：块体过渡金属二硫属化物多型体4Hb-TaS₂，具体研究其1T和1H交替层之间产生的非公度势，以及该势与电荷密度波、电子关联和超导电性之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在4Hb-TaS₂中，1T与1H层间的晶格失配产生了非公度势，该势与共存的非公度电荷密度波相互竞争，抑制了长程有序，并通过调制层间距局域地调控关联1T层与金属性1H层之间的杂化和电荷转移，将系统驱动至掺杂的Mott绝缘体区域，同时体超导电性与该势和电荷转移存在竞争关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在4Hb-TaS₂中，1T与1H层间的晶格失配产生了非公度势，该势与共存的非公度电荷密度波相互竞争，抑制了长程有序，并通过调制层间距局域地调控关联1T层与金属性1H层之间的杂化和电荷转移，将系统驱动至掺杂的Mott绝缘体区域，同时体超导电性与该势和电荷转移存在竞争关系。；创新点：首次在块体混合过渡金属二硫属化物中识别出非公度势（moiré势）的存在，并揭示其作为此前被忽视的关键因素，在电子关联、电荷密度波序和非常规超导电性的相互竞争中发挥核心作用。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）；理论上结合密度泛函理论（DFT）与动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。

papers.title: The cell fluid model with Curie-Weiss interactions: special cases and analytical results
papers.abstract: Inspired by previous extensive numerical studies of a cell fluid model with Curie-Weiss interactions, we concentrate on some analytically tractable special cases in its description. The key ingredient of the model is a competition between global attraction and local repulsion interactions between particles with coupling constants $J_1$ and $J_2$, respectively. We provide analytical results in several limiting cases, including the ideal-gas limit $J_1=J_2=0$ and the strong-repulsion limit $J_2\gg J_1$. For $J_2\gg J_1$, a detailed analytical study is presented. We derive explicit expressions for the critical point parameters, the equation of state, and the binodal and spinodal curves in closed form. The equation of state is found to be in full agreement with that of the van der Waals lattice gas, and the order parameter satisfies the standard Curie-Weiss equation. In a neighborhood of the critical point, a Landau expansion is shown to have the same form and symmetry as that of the classical lattice gas within the mean-field approximation. Moreover, based on the explicit knowledge of a few leading terms in the asymptotic expansion of the deformed exponential function governing the physics of the cell model, we extend its validity range to include the marginal case of thermodynamic stability, $J_1=J_2$. In particular, this extension makes a consideration of the ideal-gas limit $J_1=J_2=0$ formally legitimate. For the generic marginal case $J_1=J_2\ne0$ systematically avoided in previous works, we present numerical data and phase diagrams that augment their findings for $J_2>J_1$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical results、analytical study、Landau expansion、mean-field approximation。；研究对象：具有Curie-Weiss相互作用的细胞流体模型（cell fluid model），具体研究粒子间全局吸引（耦合常数J1）与局域排斥（耦合常数J2）竞争导致的相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强排斥极限（J2≫J1）下，该模型的状态方程与范德华晶格气体完全一致，序参量满足标准Curie-Weiss方程；在临界点附近，其朗道展开形式与平均场近似下的经典晶格气体具有相同形式和对称性。此外，通过解析延拓，将模型的有效性扩展至热力学稳定性的边缘情况（J1=J2）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强排斥极限（J2≫J1）下，该模型的状态方程与范德华晶格气体完全一致，序参量满足标准Curie-Weiss方程；在临界点附近，其朗道展开形式与平均场近似下的经典晶格气体具有相同形式和对称性。此外，通过解析延拓，将模型的有效性扩展至热力学稳定性的边缘情况（J1=J2）。；创新点：首次对强排斥极限（J2≫J1）下的临界点参数、状态方程、双节线和旋节线给出了闭合形式的解析表达式；并首次将模型分析扩展至先前工作中系统回避的边缘情况J1=J2≠0，提供了该情况下的数值数据和相图。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导：针对理想气体极限（J1=J2=0）、强排斥极限（J2≫J1）以及边缘情况（J1=J2）进行解析求解；使用朗道展开分析临界行为；利用变形指数函数的渐近展开进行解析延拓；对边缘情况辅以数值计算和相图绘制。

papers.title: Observation of magnetically switchable quantum geometric photocurrents
papers.abstract: In non-centrosymmetric materials, light can be rectified into two types of DC photocurrents, known as injection and shift currents, through the bulk photovoltaic effect. Recent theory has uncovered their deep relation with the two-state quantum geometry of resonant transitions: In non-magnetic crystals, where these currents have been routinely observed, the injection current responds to circular light and probes the Berry curvature, while the shift current responds to linear light and probes the geometric connection. Magnetic crystals have been predicted to show a new set of hitherto unobserved magnetically switchable photocurrents, with the roles of linear and circular light interchanged: A linear injection current, which probes the quantum metric, and a circular shift current, which probes the geometric torsion. In this work, we demonstrate the existence of such currents for the first time, demonstrating the switching of the current by flipping the Néel vector in a van der Waals antiferromagnet. Furthermore, their specific frequency and temperature dependence confirm the assignment of circular shift and linear injection currents. Our work demonstrates a new way to control photocurrents in magnets that are directly tied to geometry and have promising applications in antiferromagnetic spintronics and light harvesting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate the existence of such currents for the first time”、“demonstrating the switching of the current by flipping the Néel vector”等实验观测和验证表述。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯反铁磁体中的磁可开关量子几何光电流，具体包括线性注入电流（探测量子度量）和圆移电流（探测几何挠率）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次实验观测到磁性晶体中预测的磁可开关光电流——线性注入电流和圆移电流，并通过翻转反铁磁体的奈尔矢量实现了电流的开关控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次实验观测到磁性晶体中预测的磁可开关光电流——线性注入电流和圆移电流，并通过翻转反铁磁体的奈尔矢量实现了电流的开关控制。；创新点：首次在实验上证实了磁性晶体中预测的、与量子几何直接相关的两类新型光电流（线性注入电流和圆移电流），并展示了通过反铁磁序参量（奈尔矢量）翻转实现光电流开关的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过光电流测量，结合频率和温度依赖关系分析，确认了圆移电流和线性注入电流的归属。具体实验手段摘要未明确说明，但涉及对范德瓦尔斯反铁磁体的光激发和电流检测。

papers.title: Revisiting the high-field phase diagram of the topological cubic helimagnet SrFeO$_{3}$
papers.abstract: The cubic perovskite SrFeO$_{3}$ is a prototypical centrosymmetric itinerant magnet that hosts a quadruple-${\mathbf Q}$ hedgehog-antihedgehog lattice and exhibits a complex magnetic-field-temperature phase diagram. Yet, the microscopic mechanism underlying the emergence of its versatile multiple-${\mathbf Q}$ phases remains unresolved. Here, we elucidate the field-orientation dependence of the magnetic phase diagram and establish an effective spin Hamiltonian for SrFeO$_{3}$ that incorporates a cubic single-ion anisotropy together with bilinear and biquadratic interactions in momentum space. In addition, we observe magnetoelastic signatures of a first-order valence transition upon entering the forced FM phase at 40 T, which would be attributed to the suppression of negative charge transfer. These findings emphasize the pivotal importance of electronic itinerancy arising from the formation of a ligand-hole band in stabilizing multiple-${\mathbf Q}$ phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“建立有效自旋哈密顿量”（理论建模）以及“观测到磁弹性信号”（实验观测）。；研究对象：拓扑立方螺旋磁体 SrFeO₃ 在高磁场下的相图，特别是其多重-Q 相（如四-Q  hedgehog-antihedgehog 格子）的微观机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了包含立方单离子各向异性、动量空间双线性与双二次相互作用的有效自旋哈密顿量，阐明了磁场方向对相图的影响；在40 T进入强迫铁磁相时观测到一级价态转变的磁弹性信号，归因于负电荷转移被抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了包含立方单离子各向异性、动量空间双线性与双二次相互作用的有效自旋哈密顿量，阐明了磁场方向对相图的影响；在40 T进入强迫铁磁相时观测到一级价态转变的磁弹性信号，归因于负电荷转移被抑制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过实验测量磁弹性信号（如晶格应变或超声响应）并结合理论建模（包含立方单离子各向异性、双线性与双二次交换作用的动量空间自旋哈密顿量）进行分析。

papers.title: A sulfonitride transparent conductive thin film with ultra-high refractive index
papers.abstract: With the rise of AI-assisted materials screening, extraordinary properties are now frequently predicted in experimentally uncharted material systems, highlighting the need to develop new synthesis methods for unconventional materials beyond the classic bulk powder form. Here, we establish the first thin-film growth route for any metal sulfonitride compound by realizing Zr2SN2 films with a rare and compelling combination of optical and electrical properties. Zr2SN2 is transparent across most of the visible range while exhibiting a very high average refractive index of 2.95 in the visible, exceeding expectations based on conventional refractive index-bandgap scaling. Importantly, the same Zr2SN2 film shows degenerate n-type conductivity with carrier density above 10^20 cm-3 and intragrain mobility above 8 cm2V-1s-1, approaching those of established transparent conductive oxides. Zr2SN2 thus demonstrates that strong light-matter interaction, optical transparency and electrical conductivity can be reconciled within a single material platform, revealing a new class of high-refractive-index transparent conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：thin-film growth route（薄膜生长方法）、optical and electrical properties（光电性能测量）。；研究对象：Zr₂SN₂薄膜，一种金属硫氮化物（sulfonitride）透明导电薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Zr₂SN₂薄膜在可见光范围内透明，同时具有极高的平均折射率（2.95）和接近传统透明导电氧化物的简并n型导电性（载流子浓度>10²⁰ cm⁻³，晶粒内迁移率>8 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹），首次在单一材料中实现了强光-物质相互作用、光学透明性与导电性的统一。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Zr₂SN₂薄膜在可见光范围内透明，同时具有极高的平均折射率（2.95）和接近传统透明导电氧化物的简并n型导电性（载流子浓度>10²⁰ cm⁻³，晶粒内迁移率>8 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹），首次在单一材料中实现了强光-物质相互作用、光学透明性与导电性的统一。；创新点：首次实现了任何金属硫氮化物化合物的薄膜生长，并发现其兼具超高折射率与透明导电性，突破了传统折射率-带隙标度关系的预期，开辟了高折射率透明导体的新材料类别。
papers.method_zh: 首次建立了金属硫氮化物化合物的薄膜生长路线（具体生长方法摘要未明确说明），并进行了光学（折射率、透光性）和电学（载流子浓度、迁移率）性能表征。

papers.title: Current-driven reduction of topological protection in multichannel superconductors
papers.abstract: We investigate the robustness of topological phases in a Kitaev ladder composed of two coupled superconducting chains under the perturbing influence of a finite charge current. By introducing an effective Hamiltonian depending on the quasiparticle momentum induced by the current, we show that the two-mode topological phase, present in the isolated ladder, is fragile against a finite current flux. To characterize this behavior, we combine bulk topological invariants with real-space diagnostics, including the edge-edge quantum conditional mutual information Iee, which provides an entanglement-based signature of topological order. Our results provide an effective framework to describe how current injection and measurement processes can affect topological protection in superconducting nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“introducing an effective Hamiltonian”、“combine bulk topological invariants with real-space diagnostics”、“provide an effective framework”。；研究对象：Kitaev梯子（由两条耦合超导链构成的多通道超导体）在有限电荷电流扰动下的拓扑相稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 孤立Kitaev梯子中存在的双模拓扑相在有限电流通量下是脆弱的，即电流会削弱拓扑保护。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：孤立Kitaev梯子中存在的双模拓扑相在有限电流通量下是脆弱的，即电流会削弱拓扑保护。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过引入依赖于电流诱导的准粒子动量的有效哈密顿量，结合体拓扑不变量与实空间诊断（包括基于纠缠的拓扑序标志——边-边量子条件互信息Iee）进行分析。

papers.title: Harnessing Linear and Nonlinear Optical Responses in Ferroelectric LaMoN$_3$ for Enhanced Photovoltaic Efficiency
papers.abstract: Nitride perovskites are an emerging class of materials predicted to exhibit diverse functional properties, yet remain underexplored due to synthesis challenges of oxygen-free nitrides. Recently, LaMoN$_3$ has been reported as an oxygen-free nitride perovskite with polar symmetry, exhibiting excellent dynamic stability and ferroelectric properties under moderate pressure. However, its phase stability, linear and non-linear optical response, excitonic and polaronic behavior, and efficiency under high pressure remain unexplored. Applying pressure enables systematic tuning of the electronic structure properties, thereby facilitating the identification of phases optimized for either linear or nonlinear optical responses. Therefore, in this work, we systematically investigate these properties of LaMoN$_3$ up to 40 GPa using first-principles methods, including density functional theory, density functional perturbation theory, many-body perturbation theory (namely G$_0$W$_0$ and BSE), and tight binding approximation model. Our study shows that LaMoN$_3$ remains dynamically stable and retains its single-phase structure up to 40 GPa. The compound exhibits an indirect bandgap that decreases from 2.17 eV (0 GPa) to 1.45 eV (40 GPa) at the G$_0$W$_0$@PBE level. Using the BSE, we find that pressure enhances the SLME while lowering the exciton binding energy, both favorable for photovoltaic applications. The bulk photovoltaic efficiency trend with pressure mimics the behavior of the shift current density J$_SC$ , peaking near 15 GPa before declining at higher pressures due to a diminished nonlinear shift current response. These results highlight pressure-tuned regimes to enhance photovoltaic performance. We thereby propose multi-junction device, combining absorber layers optimized for linear and nonlinear optical currents, together boosting solar energy conversion through complementary mechanisms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles methods”、“density functional theory”、“density functional perturbation theory”、“many-body perturbation theory (namely G₀W₀ and BSE)”、“tight binding approximation model”。；研究对象：氧自由氮化物钙钛矿LaMoN₃在高压下（0-40 GPa）的线性与非线性光学响应、激子与极化子行为，以及其光伏效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LaMoN₃在40 GPa内保持动态稳定，压力可调控其带隙（从2.17 eV降至1.45 eV），并增强光谱极限最大效率（SLME）同时降低激子结合能；体光伏效率在15 GPa附近达到峰值，随后因非线性位移电流响应减弱而下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LaMoN₃在40 GPa内保持动态稳定，压力可调控其带隙（从2.17 eV降至1.45 eV），并增强光谱极限最大效率（SLME）同时降低激子结合能；体光伏效率在15 GPa附近达到峰值，随后因非线性位移电流响应减弱而下降。；创新点：首次系统研究了LaMoN₃在高压下的相稳定性、线性/非线性光学响应、激子与极化子行为，并揭示了压力调控可优化光伏性能的机制，进而提出结合线性与非线性光学电流的多结器件设计思路。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算，具体包括：密度泛函理论（DFT）、密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）、多体微扰理论（G₀W₀@PBE和BSE方法）、紧束缚近似模型。

papers.title: Transport Enhancement and In Situ Control of Electronic Correlation via Photoinduced Modulation Doping of van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Modulation doping, a well-established technique for traditional semiconductor heterostructures, is a promising approach for tailoring carrier concentration in 2D materials devices. In this letter we report on photoinduced modulation doping in hBN-graphene-hBN-SiO2 heterostructures utilizing standard white light sources and no additional fabrication complexity. We establish the use of this technique to both dope the channel material and to photoanneal devices, providing control over electronic doping and disorder in the graphene channel. We analyze the transport properties by employing Drude and Landauer transport models, highlighting the ability to reversibly tune the mobility and mean scattering length of the graphene with a high degree of accuracy. This tunability allows us to switch our device between the diffusive and quasi-ballistic transport regimes in situ. We utilize the exceptional control our technique provides over local disorder to realize quantum Hall isospin ferromagnetic states in a device whose initial quality would otherwise leave such states unobservable. These results demonstrate precise manipulation of carrier density and charge disorder in van der Waals heterostructures, providing a highly accessible approach to creating high-quality devices capable of realizing correlated electronic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“report on photoinduced modulation doping”、“analyze the transport properties”、“utilize the exceptional control... to realize quantum Hall isospin ferromagnetic states”等实验操作与观测。；研究对象：hBN-石墨烯-hBN-SiO₂范德华异质结中的电子输运现象，特别是通过光诱导调制掺杂实现对载流子浓度和电荷无序的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用标准白光光源即可在范德华异质结中实现光诱导调制掺杂，从而可逆且高精度地调控石墨烯的迁移率和平均散射长度，使器件在扩散输运与准弹道输运之间原位切换，并能在初始质量较差的器件中实现原本不可观测的量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用标准白光光源即可在范德华异质结中实现光诱导调制掺杂，从而可逆且高精度地调控石墨烯的迁移率和平均散射长度，使器件在扩散输运与准弹道输运之间原位切换，并能在初始质量较差的器件中实现原本不可观测的量子霍尔同位旋铁磁态。；创新点：无需额外复杂制备工艺，仅用标准白光即可实现传统半导体异质结中成熟的调制掺杂技术，并同时具备光退火功能，实现对电子掺杂和电荷无序的原位、可逆、高精度控制，从而在低质量器件中实现高质量器件才可观测的关联电子态。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准白光光源进行光诱导调制掺杂，结合Drude模型和Landauer输运模型分析输运性质，通过测量迁移率、平均散射长度等参数表征电子掺杂和电荷无序的调控效果，并观测量子霍尔态中的同位旋铁磁态。

papers.title: Interaction-enabled metal-insulator phase transition in a driven quantum gas
papers.abstract: Particle transport and energy flow are central for our understanding of a wealth of phenomena in physics and the natural sciences. Interactions are generically expected to promote ergodicity and diffusive behavior, yet quantum interference can arrest transport and prevent energy absorption, defying classical expectations. How interactions and quantum coherence compete remains a fundamental open question. Here, we experimentally investigate their interplay in a periodically driven, three-dimensional (3D) quantum gas with tunable interactions. Strikingly, we find that interactions give rise to a sharp dynamical boundary that separates localization from diffusive energy absorption. By tuning the driving amplitude and interaction strength, we map the localization-delocalization phase diagram and characterize the boundary via finite-time scaling. On the insulating side, we observe many-body dynamical localization (MBDL) for a wide range of parameters, finding arrested transport in momentum space. Near the boundary, transport becomes subdiffusive, whereas in the delocalized regime we observe classical diffusion, yielding a metal-insulator transition that we interpret in terms of localization in many-body Hilbert space. Our results exemplify an interaction-enabled dynamical phase transition in a closed Floquet many-body system and clarify how coherence and interactions jointly govern the quantum-to-classical transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimentally investigate、periodically driven、3D quantum gas、tunable interactions。；研究对象：周期性驱动的三维量子气体中的相互作用诱导的金属-绝缘体相变，具体为动量空间中的局域化与扩散输运之间的动力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相互作用在周期性驱动的三维量子气体中产生了一个尖锐的动力学边界，将局域化（多体动力学局域化）与扩散性能量吸收（经典扩散）分开，实现了相互作用驱动的金属-绝缘体相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相互作用在周期性驱动的三维量子气体中产生了一个尖锐的动力学边界，将局域化（多体动力学局域化）与扩散性能量吸收（经典扩散）分开，实现了相互作用驱动的金属-绝缘体相变。；创新点：首次在封闭的Floquet多体系统中实验展示了相互作用驱动的动力学相变，揭示了相互作用与量子相干性如何共同主导量子到经典的转变，并在动量空间中观察到多体动力学局域化。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用具有可调相互作用的周期性驱动三维量子气体，通过改变驱动振幅和相互作用强度，绘制局域化-退局域化相图，并利用有限时间标度分析表征相变边界。

papers.title: Emergent magnetic and charge ordered phases in freestanding ultrathin \ce{LaVO3}
papers.abstract: Transition metal oxide perovskites are an ideal platform for exploring the interplay between spin, orbital, charge and lattice degrees of freedom. Among them, \ce{LaVO3} has been extensively studied in heterostructures and superlattices, where exotic phases have been reported. Motivated by the advances in freestanding oxide membranes, we investigate the intrinsic properties of freestanding ultrathin \ce{LaVO3} films using density functional theory. Our calculations reveal a sequence of magnetic phase transitions with thickness, starting from stripe-AFM in monolayer until the bulk like C-AFM is recovered. Beyond four layers, polar catastrophe driven charge transfer dopes the surface layers giving rise to stripe-AFM and ferromagnetic surface states while the central layers remain bulk like. We further explore this fact by studying charge doped monolayer, discovering that hole doping drives the system into ferromagnetic state. Doping also induced charge ordering in the system. A striped charge ordering pattern is observed at 0.5 h/fu, while a 3:1 stripe pattern emerges at 0.25 h/fu, indicating that the periodicity of the superstructure changes with doping concentration.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory”（密度泛函理论）、“calculations”。；研究对象：自由站立超薄 \ce{LaVO3} 薄膜。具体体系包括单层至多层薄膜，以及电荷掺杂的单层 \ce{LaVO3}。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自由站立超薄 \ce{LaVO3} 薄膜的磁序随厚度发生系列转变：从单层的条纹反铁磁（stripe-AFM）到体相类C型反铁磁（C-AFM）。超过四层后，极化灾难驱动的电荷转移使表面层出现条纹反铁磁和铁磁态，而中心层保持体相行为。此外，空穴掺杂可诱导铁磁态和不同周期性的条纹电荷有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自由站立超薄 \ce{LaVO3} 薄膜的磁序随厚度发生系列转变：从单层的条纹反铁磁（stripe-AFM）到体相类C型反铁磁（C-AFM）。超过四层后，极化灾难驱动的电荷转移使表面层出现条纹反铁磁和铁磁态，而中心层保持体相行为。此外，空穴掺杂可诱导铁磁态和不同周期性的条纹电荷有序。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Self-organization and memory formation in two-dimensional jammed deformable matter under cyclic compression
papers.abstract: We study the athermal mechanical response of deformable ring assemblies to quasistatic compression. Beyond jamming, further densification induces buckling of rings, resulting in macroscopic mechanical softening. Under cyclic compression, monodisperse systems anneal toward a nearly reversible path passing through an ordered state, whereas polydisperse systems converge to stable, hysteretic limit cycles. These limit cycles encode a robust memory of the training history that is retained even under subsequent overdriving. We show that macroscopic hysteresis in the disordered packings originates from directionally asymmetric non-affine deformations at the microscale while keeping contact network largely intact. Our findings demonstrate how particle deformability governs collective self-organization and memory formation in jammed soft matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：athermal mechanical response（非热力学响应）、quasistatic compression（准静态压缩）、numerical simulation（数值模拟，隐含于对环组装体变形行为的系统研究）。；研究对象：二维可变形环组装体（deformable ring assemblies）在准静态循环压缩下的力学响应，特别是堵塞（jamming）后的自组织与记忆形成现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单分散体系在循环压缩下退火至近乎可逆的有序路径，而多分散体系收敛至稳定的迟滞极限环，该极限环编码了训练历史的鲁棒记忆，即使后续过驱动仍能保留。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单分散体系在循环压缩下退火至近乎可逆的有序路径，而多分散体系收敛至稳定的迟滞极限环，该极限环编码了训练历史的鲁棒记忆，即使后续过驱动仍能保留。；创新点：揭示了粒子可变形性（deformability）如何主导堵塞软物质中的集体自组织与记忆形成机制，特别是发现无序堆积中宏观迟滞源于微观尺度上方向性不对称的非仿射变形，而接触网络基本保持完整。
papers.method_zh: 采用非热准静态压缩模拟，通过分析单分散与多分散环组装体的微观非仿射变形方向不对称性，以及接触网络的完整性，揭示宏观迟滞的微观起源。

papers.title: Aggregation-Fragmentation Processes with Broken Detailed Balance
papers.abstract: We study aggregation-fragmentation processes in which pairs of clusters can aggregate, and each cluster can break into two fragments. If the rates of aggregation and fragmentation do not depend on the masses, detailed balance does not hold, but nonequilibrium steady states can still be deduced from an exact solution for the Laplace transform. For models in which aggregation rates remain constant but fragmentation rates scale as $(\text{mass})^β$, detailed balance holds only when $β=1$. Away from this solvable case, we employ asymptotic techniques and show that when $β\geq 0$, the steady states share similarities with those from the mass-independent ($β=0$) model. An instantaneous shattering transition with continuous mass loss occurs when $β<0$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution、asymptotic techniques、Laplace transform。；研究对象：聚合-碎裂过程（aggregation-fragmentation processes），具体研究团簇对聚合与团簇碎裂的动力学，重点关注详细平衡（detailed balance）被破坏时的非平衡稳态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当聚合速率恒定、碎裂速率与质量β次方成正比时，仅当β=1时详细平衡成立；当β≥0时，稳态行为与质量无关模型（β=0）相似；当β<0时，系统发生瞬时碎裂相变（shattering transition），伴随连续质量损失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当聚合速率恒定、碎裂速率与质量β次方成正比时，仅当β=1时详细平衡成立；当β≥0时，稳态行为与质量无关模型（β=0）相似；当β<0时，系统发生瞬时碎裂相变（shattering transition），伴随连续质量损失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过拉普拉斯变换精确求解非平衡稳态；对β≠1的情况采用渐近分析（asymptotic techniques）研究稳态行为。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetic Ordering Enhanced Magnetic Damping in Mn2Au/CoFeB Bilayers
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFMs) hold significant potential for spintronic devices owing to their insensitivity to external magnetic fields and the absence of stray fields. Beyond these inherent advantages, an AFM can manipulate the magnetic dynamics of a ferromagnet (FM) layer in AFM/FM bilayers, whereas the mechanism of such manipulation remains controversial. Here, we investigate the magnetic dynamics of AFM/FM Mn2Au/CoFeB bilayers via Ferromagnetic Resonance (FMR). It is found that the Néel temperature of 2-nm-thick Mn2Au is as low as ~40 K, in sharp contrast to that of bulk Mn2Au, which exceeds 1000 K. In the Mn2Au(2 nm)/CoFeB(4 nm) bilayer, the magnetic damping $α$ of the CoFeB layer increases from 0.013 to 0.047 as temperature decreases from 160 K to 10 K, accompanied by a synchronous increase in the exchange coupling field H_rot. Such an increase in $α$ is attributed to the enhanced spin angular momentum transfer from CoFeB to Mn2Au, mediated through AFM-FM exchange coupling between Mn2Au and CoFeB, which is enhanced by the Mn2Au antiferromagnetic ordering as the temperature decreases. Our study provides deeper insights into AFM/FM dynamics and spintronic storage technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过铁磁共振（FMR）研究”，并给出了具体实验测量结果（如阻尼系数α、交换耦合场H_rot随温度的变化）。；研究对象：AFM/FM双层膜体系，具体为Mn₂Au/CoFeB异质结，研究其磁动力学行为，特别是反铁磁有序对铁磁层磁阻尼的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Mn₂Au(2 nm)/CoFeB(4 nm)双层膜中，随着温度从160 K降至10 K，CoFeB层的磁阻尼α从0.013增大至0.047，同时交换耦合场H_rot同步增大。这一增强归因于Mn₂Au反铁磁有序随温度降低而增强，从而通过AFM-FM交换耦合促进了从CoFeB到Mn₂Au的自旋角动量转移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Mn₂Au(2 nm)/CoFeB(4 nm)双层膜中，随着温度从160 K降至10 K，CoFeB层的磁阻尼α从0.013增大至0.047，同时交换耦合场H_rot同步增大。这一增强归因于Mn₂Au反铁磁有序随温度降低而增强，从而通过AFM-FM交换耦合促进了从CoFeB到Mn₂Au的自旋角动量转移。；创新点：首次在Mn₂Au/CoFeB双层膜中观察到反铁磁有序增强铁磁层磁阻尼的现象，并揭示了其与AFM-FM交换耦合的关联，为理解AFM/FM动力学提供了新见解。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 铁磁共振（FMR）技术，用于测量磁阻尼和交换耦合场随温度的变化。

papers.title: Multipolar exchange in a many-body homonuclear mixture of atoms in different internal states
papers.abstract: We develop a general method for constructing the many-body Hamiltonian of pairwise interactions describing homonuclear mixtures of atoms occupying states with different total angular momenta or other quantum numbers. The advantage of the irreducible spherical tensor operator formalism is demonstrated: these operators give the Hamiltonian an explicit physical structure, account for all scattering channels, and include multipolar exchange interactions. The latter correspond to the exchange of both angular-momentum projections and the total angular momentum. Particular realizations of the general Hamiltonian, widely used in the physics of ultracold gases, are also analyzed. The resulting Hamiltonian provides a universal framework for investigating a broad range of quantum many-body phenomena in bosonic and fermionic atomic gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“develop a general method”、“irreducible spherical tensor operator formalism”、“Hamiltonian”。；研究对象：处于不同内态（如不同总角动量或其他量子数）的同核原子多体混合物中的多极交换相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用不可约球张量算符形式，可以系统构建描述同核原子混合物中两体相互作用的通用多体哈密顿量，该哈密顿量显式包含多极交换相互作用，即同时交换角动量投影和总角动量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用不可约球张量算符形式，可以系统构建描述同核原子混合物中两体相互作用的通用多体哈密顿量，该哈密顿量显式包含多极交换相互作用，即同时交换角动量投影和总角动量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用不可约球张量算符形式论，构建多体哈密顿量的通用理论框架，并分析了该哈密顿量在超冷气体物理中的具体实现。

papers.title: Generation of an anomalous linearly dispersing spin-polarized band in Bi-based topological insulators
papers.abstract: We report the generation of an anomalous linearly dispersing, spin-polarized band in Bi-based topological insulator (TI) thin films, induced by soft Ar-ion bombardment followed by annealing. This extra band -- which we call the anomalous linearly dispersing state (ALS) -- is superimposed on the regular band structure including the topological surface state (TSS), spans an unusually large energetic range of up to ${\sim}\,\SI{650}{\milli\electronvolt}$ at the $Γ$-point, and appears near the Fermi energy. Spin-resolved measurements indicate spin-momentum locking with a helicity \emph{opposite} to that of the regular TSS. The Fermi velocity of the ALS, $v_\mathrm{F} = (5.1\pm 0.4)\times 10^{5}\,\frac m s$, is indistinguishable from that of the regular TSS, $(5.3\pm 0.5)\times 10^{5}\,\frac m s$. The observation is reproducible across samples of varying thickness and was confirmed at two independent synchrotron radiation facilities. We discuss different mechanisms for the physical origin of the observed ALS including sputtering-induced TSS relocation, bi-layer formation by,e.g., chalcogen removal, and high-index surface relocation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“We report”、“Spin-resolved measurements”、“observed”、“confirmed at two independent synchrotron radiation facilities”。；研究对象：Bi基拓扑绝缘体薄膜中由氩离子轰击和退火诱导产生的一种反常线性色散自旋极化能带（称为ALS）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bi基拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，通过软氩离子轰击后退火，可以产生一个反常的线性色散自旋极化能带（ALS），该能带叠加在包括拓扑表面态（TSS）在内的常规能带结构上，具有与常规TSS相反的自旋-动量锁定螺旋性，且费米速度与常规TSS几乎相同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bi基拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，通过软氩离子轰击后退火，可以产生一个反常的线性色散自旋极化能带（ALS），该能带叠加在包括拓扑表面态（TSS）在内的常规能带结构上，具有与常规TSS相反的自旋-动量锁定螺旋性，且费米速度与常规TSS几乎相同。；创新点：发现了一种新的反常线性色散态（ALS），其自旋螺旋性与常规拓扑表面态相反，且能量范围异常大（在Γ点可达约650 meV），为理解拓扑绝缘体表面态调控提供了新途径。摘要未突出说明与已有理论或实验工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 软氩离子轰击结合退火处理制备样品；自旋分辨测量（Spin-resolved measurements）用于探测自旋-动量锁定特性；在两个独立同步辐射设施上进行实验验证。

papers.title: Improvement of piezocatalytic performance of Na0.5Bi0.5TiO3 perovskite using K doping for efficient Rhodamine B degradation
papers.abstract: Piezocatalysis, based on the piezoelectric properties of catalysts, breaks down the barrier between mechanical energy and chemical energy. It describes the use of charges induced by piezoelectricity to assist typical chemical processes while harvesting various forms of mechanical green energy. The performance of piezocatalysis is predominantly governed by the piezoelectric properties of materials. The main aim of this work is to evaluate and analyze the potential of potassium doped sodium bismuth titanate Na0.5-xKxBi0.5TiO3 abbreviated as NKxBT (0, 0.15, 0.20, and 0.25), as a piezocatalyst in the degradation of the organic dye Rhodamine B RhB under ultrasonic vibration. The synthesis of NKxBT nanopowders was conducted using the sol-gel autocombustion method. Coupled structural analysis reveals the presence of an intermediate Morphotropic Phase Boundary (MPB, where two phases coexist) in the optimal NK15BT composition. The piezocatalytic degradation results showed a total piezo-degradation in only 90 min and a rate constant 8 times higher than the undoped NK0BT. The enhanced piezocatalytic activity results from a synergistic effect of MPB presence, reduced particle size, optimal bandgap and high lattice strain. The NK15BT sample also demonstrated good reusability and good mineralization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：synthesis（合成）、piezocatalytic degradation results（压电催化降解结果）、reusability（可重复使用性）。；研究对象：钾掺杂的钛酸铋钠钙钛矿（Na₀.₅₋ₓKₓBi₀.₅TiO₃，简称NKxBT），作为压电催化剂用于降解有机染料罗丹明B（Rhodamine B, RhB）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 最优掺杂比例NK15BT（x=0.15）在90分钟内实现罗丹明B的完全压电降解，其降解速率常数是未掺杂样品的8倍。性能提升源于形貌相界（MPB）的存在、粒径减小、最佳带隙和高晶格应变的协同效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：最优掺杂比例NK15BT（x=0.15）在90分钟内实现罗丹明B的完全压电降解，其降解速率常数是未掺杂样品的8倍。性能提升源于形貌相界（MPB）的存在、粒径减小、最佳带隙和高晶格应变的协同效应。；创新点：通过钾掺杂在Na₀.₅Bi₀.₅TiO₃中引入形貌相界（MPB），显著提升压电催化降解有机染料的性能。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用溶胶-凝胶自燃烧法合成NKxBT纳米粉末；通过耦合结构分析（coupled structural analysis）确认形貌相界（MPB）；利用超声振动驱动压电催化降解实验，并测试可重复使用性和矿化程度。

papers.title: Two-dimensional alternating ferrimagnetism with strain-controlled half-metallic state and valley polarization
papers.abstract: The discovery of altermagnetism offers new opportunities for exploring novel quantum states and developing spintronic devices for enabling momentum dependent spin splitting in compensated systems, while zero net magnetization limit its manipulability using conventional magnetic method. Here, we propose 2D alternating ferrimagnetism,a phase merging alternating momentum dependent spin splitting with a finite net magnetization. A tight binding model reveals that alternating ferrimagnetism originates from uncompensated magnetization in altermagnets, facilitating concurrent net magnetization and alternating spin splitting. First principles calculations and Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate stable alternating ferrimagnetism in strained and Cr substiting V2Te2O, which exhibit strain tunable net magnetization, reversable half metallicity and valley polarization, accompanied by long range magnetic order above room temperature. By combining altermagnetic and ferromagnetic properties, alternating ferrimagnetism expand the 2D magnetism landscape and offer pathways for energy efficient spintronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+计算）。判断依据：tight binding model（紧束缚模型）、First principles calculations（第一性原理计算）、Monte Carlo simulations（蒙特卡洛模拟）。；研究对象：二维交变铁磁体（2D alternating ferrimagnetism），具体材料为应变和Cr替代的V₂Te₂O体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出二维交变铁磁体这一新物相，它同时具有交变动量依赖的自旋劈裂和有限净磁化强度；在应变和Cr替代的V₂Te₂O中，该相表现出应变可调的净磁化强度、可逆的半金属性和谷极化，且具有高于室温的长程磁序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出二维交变铁磁体这一新物相，它同时具有交变动量依赖的自旋劈裂和有限净磁化强度；在应变和Cr替代的V₂Te₂O中，该相表现出应变可调的净磁化强度、可逆的半金属性和谷极化，且具有高于室温的长程磁序。；创新点：首次提出“交变铁磁体”（alternating ferrimagnetism）概念，将交变磁体（altermagnet）的动量依赖自旋劈裂与铁磁体的有限净磁化强度相结合，克服了传统交变磁体因零净磁化强度而难以用常规磁学方法调控的局限。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚模型（tight binding model）用于揭示交变铁磁性的起源；第一性原理计算（First principles calculations）和蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）用于验证材料中的稳定性和物理性质。

papers.title: Possible Topological Decoherence Transition in Relativistic Electron Beams Propagating through Coulomb-Disordered Media
papers.abstract: We show that the mutual coherence of a relativistic electron beam in a Coulomb-disordered medium is governed by an effective two-dimensional compact phase field with a logarithmic correlation function. The corresponding Gaussian free-field action exhibits a stiffness inversely proportional to the propagation length. When the compact nature of the phase is taken into account, the system supports vortex excitations that interact as a two-dimensional Coulomb gas. Renormalization-group analysis of this gas indicates the existence of a critical sample thickness $L_c$ at which a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition may occur, separating a regime of algebraic decoherence from one where free vortices proliferate and coherence is destroyed exponentially. The critical thickness is expressed through fundamental microscopic parameters and could be observed in transmission electron microscopy of liquid cells or cryogenic samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Renormalization-group analysis、effective two-dimensional compact phase field、Gaussian free-field action。；研究对象：相对论性电子束在库仑无序介质（如液体池或低温样品）中传播时的相互相干性，以及可能发生的拓扑退相干相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当考虑相位场的紧致性时，系统支持涡旋激发，这些涡旋相互作用类似于二维库仑气体。重整化群分析表明存在一个临界样品厚度 \(L_c\)，在该厚度处可能发生Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless（BKT）相变，将代数退相干区域与自由涡旋增殖导致指数退相干区域分开。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当考虑相位场的紧致性时，系统支持涡旋激发，这些涡旋相互作用类似于二维库仑气体。重整化群分析表明存在一个临界样品厚度 \(L_c\)，在该厚度处可能发生Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless（BKT）相变，将代数退相干区域与自由涡旋增殖导致指数退相干区域分开。；创新点：将BKT相变的概念引入到电子束在无序介质中传播的退相干问题中，并给出了临界厚度与微观参数的关系，为在透射电子显微镜实验中观测该相变提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建有效二维紧致相位场模型，推导其对数关联函数和高斯自由场作用量，并利用二维库仑气体的重整化群分析来研究涡旋激发对相干性的影响。

papers.title: Photoemission intermittency via stochastic gating in rubrene nanowires coupled to plasmonic silver nanoparticles
papers.abstract: In this work, we report a new nanoscale phenomenon observed as photoemission intermittency (On-Off electron emission), manifested as stochastic bursts in electron yield at quasi-one-dimensional organic wires and silver nanoparticles interface. Energy-resolved measurements reveal that the emitted electrons carry out hybrid information, containing photoelectron yield enhancement associated with the nanoparticles and kinetic energies determined by the organic semiconductor. The intermittency results in a dynamic shift of the electron spectra correlating with the photoelectron yield. We attribute the observed behaviour to the photo-hole accumulation and stochastic gating of charge due to electron-hole separation at the nano interface. These findings introduces the photoemission intermittency as a nanoscale phenomenon indicating a new dynamic regime of charge assisted emission at organic-plasmonic interfaces. Keywords: rubrene, nanoparticle, PEEM, exciton, charge
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“report”、“measurements”、“observed”、“PEEM”等，表明是实验观测与表征。；研究对象：准一维有机红荧烯（rubrene）纳米线与等离激元银纳米颗粒耦合形成的界面体系，以及在该界面处观测到的光发射间歇性（On-Off电子发射）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有机-等离激元纳米界面处，观测到一种新的纳米尺度现象——光发射间歇性，表现为电子产额的随机爆发式波动，该现象源于光生空穴积累与电荷的随机门控效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有机-等离激元纳米界面处，观测到一种新的纳米尺度现象——光发射间歇性，表现为电子产额的随机爆发式波动，该现象源于光生空穴积累与电荷的随机门控效应。；创新点：首次报道了有机-等离激元界面处的光发射间歇性现象，揭示了一种新的电荷辅助发射的动态机制，将光电子发射的随机开关行为与纳米界面处的电子-空穴分离及电荷积累过程联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 能量分辨光发射测量（energy-resolved photoemission measurements），结合光发射电子显微镜（PEEM）进行空间与能量分辨的电子发射表征。

papers.title: Fabrication and transfer of ultra-thin YBa$2$Cu$3$O$_{7-x}$ film on SrTiO$_3$ nanomembrane
papers.abstract: The fabrication of free-standing ultra-thin films from high-temperature (high-Tc) superconductors is of great interest for the development of superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors with high operating temperatures. We successfully fabricate a millimeter-sized, high-quality, ultra-thin YBa$2$Cu$3$O$_{7-x}$ (YBCO) film on an SrTiO$_3$/Sr$_{1.5}$Ca$_{1.5}$Al$_2$O$_6$ (STO/SCAO) bilayer using high-pressure sputtering. The STO nanomembranes with the YBCO films are released by dissolving the water-soluble SCAO sacrificial layer and transferred onto the SiO2/Si substrate. X-ray diffraction confirms that STO and YBCO crystallinity is preserved following transfer onto SiO2/Si substrates. Microbridges patterned from the transferred YBCO films exhibit a critical temperature of 88.8 K and a critical current density of 6.8 MA/cm2 at 77 K, demonstrating robust superconducting transport after transfer. The thermal boundary conductance across the van der Waals interface between the STO nanomembrane with YBCO film and the SiO2/Si substrate, measured over 15-75 K, is significantly reduced compared to that of epitaxial YBCO film on bulk STO leading to modified energy relaxation and enhanced stability of transient resistive states. These results establish ultra-thin YBCO films on optically transparent STO nanomembranes as a platform for integrating high-Tc superconducting devices with SiO2/Si-based photonic structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要详细描述了薄膜制备、转移、表征和输运测量等实验过程。；研究对象：超薄YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋ₓ（YBCO）高温超导薄膜，生长在SrTiO₃（STO）纳米膜上，并转移至SiO₂/Si衬底。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功制备并转移了毫米级、高质量的YBCO超薄薄膜，转移后薄膜仍保持88.8 K的超导临界温度和77 K下6.8 MA/cm²的高临界电流密度；且STO纳米膜与SiO₂/Si衬底之间的范德华界面导致热边界电导显著降低，有利于瞬态电阻态的稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功制备并转移了毫米级、高质量的YBCO超薄薄膜，转移后薄膜仍保持88.8 K的超导临界温度和77 K下6.8 MA/cm²的高临界电流密度；且STO纳米膜与SiO₂/Si衬底之间的范德华界面导致热边界电导显著降低，有利于瞬态电阻态的稳定。；创新点：首次实现了在光学透明的STO纳米膜上制备超薄YBCO薄膜，并将其成功转移至SiO₂/Si衬底，为将高温超导器件与硅基光子结构集成提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用高压溅射法在STO/SCAO双层上生长YBCO薄膜；通过溶解水溶性SCAO牺牲层释放STO纳米膜；将薄膜转移至SiO₂/Si衬底；使用X射线衍射确认晶体结构；通过微桥图案化测量临界温度和临界电流密度；测量15-75 K范围内的热边界电导。

papers.title: Odd-Parity Chiral Magnons in Collinear Antiferromagnetic Multiferroics: Symmetry Classification and Ferroelectric Switching
papers.abstract: The coupling between ferroelectrics and magnetism presents a promising avenue for low-dissipation spintronic devices. However, such couplings remain rare, and the direct realization of magnetic order driven by ferroelectric switching in insulators continues to pose a significant challenge. Here, we identify a class of collinear antiferromagnetic multiferroics in which intra-sublattice Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI) induces odd-parity chiral magnons that are reversible via ferroelectric switching. Leveraging the charge-neutral nature of magnons, such multiferroics enable non-volatile ferroelectric control over magnon spin splitting, Hall transport, and spin polarization in antiferromagnetic insulators. Remarkably, magnetic group analysis and spin wave calculations reveal that the chiral splitting adopts three planar odd-parity forms, f-wave, p-wave, and fully-gapped types, with an intriguing Néel vector dependence. Furthermore, density functional theory calculations validate various material candidates, ranging from two-dimensional to bulk systems. Our work provides new insights into the realization of odd-parity chiral magnons in collinear antiferromagnets and opens new avenues for magnetoelectric coupling mechanisms in multiferroics
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：对称性分析、磁群分析、自旋波计算、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。；研究对象：共线反铁磁多铁材料中由子格内Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）诱导的奇宇称手性磁振子，以及通过铁电翻转对其进行的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共线反铁磁多铁材料中，子格内DMI可诱导出具有奇宇称的手性磁振子，且该手性可通过铁电翻转实现可逆调控；手性劈裂呈现f波、p波和全能隙三种平面奇宇称形式，并依赖于奈尔矢量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共线反铁磁多铁材料中，子格内DMI可诱导出具有奇宇称的手性磁振子，且该手性可通过铁电翻转实现可逆调控；手性劈裂呈现f波、p波和全能隙三种平面奇宇称形式，并依赖于奈尔矢量。；创新点：首次在共线反铁磁体中识别出由子格内DMI诱导的奇宇称手性磁振子，并建立了其与铁电翻转的直接耦合机制，为反铁磁绝缘体中磁振子的非易失性铁电调控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 磁群对称性分析、自旋波理论计算、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Equilibrium Stabilization of a Hidden Phase Like Metallic State in 1T-TaS2
papers.abstract: Electronic phases that lie outside the equilibrium ground state offer a route to explore competing configurations in correlated materials. In 1T-TaS2, ultrafast excitation accesses a metallic hidden phase that is distinct from the commensurate insulating ground state. Here we use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to show that an equivalent electronic configuration is stabilized in exfoliated intermediate-thickness 1T-TaS2 flakes, where it persists up to room temperature before evolving through a different sequence of electronic transitions. This equilibrium hidden-phase-like state hosts a metallic band with finite Fermi-level spectral weight while retaining the characteristic hybridization gaps associated with the star-of-David band folding. These results establish a platform for controlling competing electronic states in layered materials, with implications for both quantum science and phase change technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy（ARPES）、exfoliated flakes、ultrafast excitation。；研究对象：1T-TaS2 中一种隐藏相（hidden phase）的金属态，该相不同于其公度绝缘基态，在中等厚度剥离薄片中实现平衡态稳定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等厚度的剥离 1T-TaS2 薄片中，一种与超快激发所获得的隐藏相金属态等价的电子构型可在平衡态下稳定存在，并持续至室温，同时保留星状大卫能带折叠的特征杂化能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等厚度的剥离 1T-TaS2 薄片中，一种与超快激发所获得的隐藏相金属态等价的电子构型可在平衡态下稳定存在，并持续至室温，同时保留星状大卫能带折叠的特征杂化能隙。；创新点：首次在平衡态（而非超快激发）下实现了 1T-TaS2 中隐藏相金属态的稳定，并证明该状态可在室温下持续存在，为竞争电子态的控制提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），结合机械剥离制备中等厚度 1T-TaS2 薄片。

papers.title: Enrichment of rhombohedral stacking by mechanical exfoliation of graphite
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral (ABC) graphite hosts a surface-localized flat band that supports correlated and topological electronic phases, but its experimental study is limited by the scarcity of ABC stacking in natural graphite, which is dominated by Bernal (AB) stacking. Here we show that the routine mechanical exfoliation step itself enriches the rhombohedral content of graphite flakes, and that a simple blade-assisted exfoliation step, which introduces additional shear, amplifies the effect further. Using large-area Raman 2D-band skewness mapping we measure ABC content at area fractions of 3\% in the pristine source crystal, 16\% after conventional exfoliation, and 26\% after blade-assisted exfoliation for thick flakes. In thin flakes ($<20$ layers) the per-flake area fraction reaches 75\% in the upper tail of the distribution. Tracking individual flakes before and after blade-assisted exfoliation shows that wrinkles seed AB-ABC domain walls, and uniaxial strain can move these walls. Blade-assisted mechanical exfoliation therefore removes one of the bottlenecks to the preparation of ABC-rich graphite samples for studies of correlated and topological phases in rhombohedral graphite.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验操作（机械剥离、刀片辅助剥离）和表征手段（Raman 2D-band mapping），并给出了定量的实验测量结果（ABC含量百分比）。；研究对象：菱方相（ABC堆叠）石墨。具体研究其通过机械剥离方法进行富集的物理过程，以及该过程对制备用于研究关联和拓扑电子相的ABC石墨样品的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 常规的机械剥离步骤本身就能富集石墨薄片中的菱方相（ABC堆叠）含量，而引入额外剪切力的刀片辅助剥离方法能进一步增强这一富集效果。在薄层样品（<20层）中，单片的ABC堆叠面积分数最高可达75%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：常规的机械剥离步骤本身就能富集石墨薄片中的菱方相（ABC堆叠）含量，而引入额外剪切力的刀片辅助剥离方法能进一步增强这一富集效果。在薄层样品（<20层）中，单片的ABC堆叠面积分数最高可达75%。；创新点：发现并量化了机械剥离这一常规样品制备步骤本身对菱方相石墨的富集作用，并提出了一种简单有效的刀片辅助剥离方法来进一步放大该效应。这为制备高含量ABC堆叠石墨样品提供了一条新途径，从而消除了研究菱方石墨中关联和拓扑电子相的一个关键瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用机械剥离法（包括常规剥离和刀片辅助剥离）制备石墨薄片，并利用大面积拉曼2D峰偏度映射（Raman 2D-band skewness mapping）来定量测量和区分石墨薄片中的AB（伯纳尔）和ABC（菱方）堆叠区域。通过追踪单个薄片在剥离前后的变化，研究了褶皱和单轴应变对AB-ABC畴壁的影响。

papers.title: Topological semimetals: surface transport and spin effects
papers.abstract: For the solid state physics, recent interest to topological systems is mostly connected with topological semimetals, in particular, to Weyl ones as the most representative semimetal type. Like other topological materials, e.g. topological and Chern insulators, topological semimetals acquire topologically protected surface states with linear dispersion. In contrast to helical surface states in topological insulators, the surface states are chiral for Weyl semimetals, similarly to Chern insulators, which allows to consider Weyl semimetals as the three-dimensional analog of the quantum Hall effect regime. Weyl semimetals are also interesting for spin-dependent effects, due to the spin-momentum locking in the topological surface states. For topological semimetals, the main problem of transport investigations is to reveal the surface states contribution in the material with gapless bulk spectrum. Here, we present review of experimental results on charge and spin transport in topological semimetals: charge transport in different superconducting proximity devices; spin-dependent transport; magnetic response of the topological surface states; non-linear anomalous Hall effect as the direct manifestation of the non-zero Berry curvature in topological semimetals. Possible applications are also considered for this new class of topological materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论综述文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present review of experimental results”，属于对已有实验结果的总结与理论分析，而非原创实验或计算。；研究对象：拓扑半金属，特别是外尔半金属的表面态输运与自旋效应，包括电荷输运、自旋相关输运、拓扑表面态的磁响应、非线性反常霍尔效应等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑半金属具有受拓扑保护的表面态（外尔半金属中为手性表面态），其自旋-动量锁定特性使其成为研究自旋相关效应的理想平台；通过输运实验可揭示表面态在无能隙体态中的贡献，非线性反常霍尔效应直接反映了非零贝里曲率的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑半金属具有受拓扑保护的表面态（外尔半金属中为手性表面态），其自旋-动量锁定特性使其成为研究自旋相关效应的理想平台；通过输运实验可揭示表面态在无能隙体态中的贡献，非线性反常霍尔效应直接反映了非零贝里曲率的存在。；创新点：系统总结了拓扑半金属中表面态输运与自旋效应的实验进展，特别是将外尔半金属视为量子霍尔效应态的三维类比，并讨论了其潜在应用。摘要未突出说明与以往综述的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 综述了多种实验手段：超导邻近效应器件中的电荷输运、自旋相关输运测量、拓扑表面态的磁响应测量、非线性反常霍尔效应实验。

papers.title: DMFT analysis of Hopfield network with plasticity
papers.abstract: We study a fully connected Hopfield-type associative memory network with online activity-dependent synaptic plasticity, where neural states and synaptic couplings coevolve during retrieval. Using the generating-functional formalism, we derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) in the large-system limit with extensively many stored random patterns, and show that the many-body dynamics reduces to an effective single-site stochastic process with colored Gaussian crosstalk noise and delayed feedback terms. Numerical solutions of the DMFT equations agree well with direct simulations. We find that moderate plasticity enlarges the basin of attraction and increases the maximum retrievable memory load by generating a positive delayed feedback that stabilizes retrieval against crosstalk noise. However, excessively strong plasticity causes the network to imprint the imperfect initial cue itself, leading to spurious attractors and degraded retrieval performance. Consequently, an optimal plasticity strength emerges from the trade-off between memory stabilization and premature cue imprinting. These results extend the DMFT description of associative memory to networks with coevolving neural and synaptic dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用生成泛函形式推导动力学平均场理论（DMFT），属于理论分析框架，辅以数值求解和直接模拟验证。；研究对象：具有在线活动依赖突触可塑性的全连接Hopfield型联想记忆网络，研究神经状态与突触耦合在检索过程中的共同演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 适度的突触可塑性通过产生正延迟反馈来稳定记忆检索，从而扩大吸引域并提高最大可检索记忆容量；但过强的可塑性会导致网络过早印刻不完美的初始线索，产生虚假吸引子并降低检索性能，因此存在一个最优可塑性强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：适度的突触可塑性通过产生正延迟反馈来稳定记忆检索，从而扩大吸引域并提高最大可检索记忆容量；但过强的可塑性会导致网络过早印刻不完美的初始线索，产生虚假吸引子并降低检索性能，因此存在一个最优可塑性强度。；创新点：将联想记忆的DMFT描述扩展到神经与突触动力学共同演化的网络，揭示了可塑性强度对记忆检索性能的非单调影响及最优可塑性强度的存在。
papers.method_zh: 生成泛函形式（generating-functional formalism）推导大系统极限下的动力学平均场理论（DMFT），将多体动力学约化为有效单点随机过程（含有色高斯串扰噪声和延迟反馈项），并通过数值求解DMFT方程与直接模拟进行对比验证。

papers.title: Virp: neural network-accelerated prediction of physical properties in site-disordered materials
papers.abstract: Among metallic alloys, ceramics, and even common compounds such as water ice, it is usual to find materials in which crystalline order is expressed as a probability. In such cases, one or more sites within a crystal can be occupied by multiple elements or vacancies, according to a set of probabilities. These crystal structures remain inaccessible to common first-principles materials simulation methodologies, which assumes perfect crystal order. Workaround strategies to this limitation include quasirandom structures and cluster expansion. These methods are system-specific and computationally expensive as they rely on large scale Monte Carlo simulations of enlarged unit cells. To address these limitations, we propose a pipeline combining a permutation-based virtual cell generation algorithm, sampling regime, and thermodynamic post-processing which greatly improves the feasibility of computation analyses for site-disordered materials. We demonstrate that the massive configurational space can be adequately sampled with 400 virtual cells, as long as the supercell definition is sufficiently large.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：neural network-accelerated prediction、first-principles materials simulation、quasirandom structures、cluster expansion、Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：位点无序材料（site-disordered materials），即晶体中某些位点由多种元素或空位以一定概率占据的材料，如金属合金、陶瓷、水冰等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种结合虚拟晶胞生成算法、采样方案和热力学后处理的流程，仅需400个虚拟晶胞即可充分采样巨大的构型空间，从而大幅提升位点无序材料计算分析的可行性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种结合虚拟晶胞生成算法、采样方案和热力学后处理的流程，仅需400个虚拟晶胞即可充分采样巨大的构型空间，从而大幅提升位点无序材料计算分析的可行性。；创新点：针对传统方法（如准随机结构、团簇展开）系统特异性强且依赖大规模蒙特卡罗模拟、计算成本高的问题，提出一种通用且高效的替代流程，显著降低了对超大晶胞和大量采样的需求。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种基于排列的虚拟晶胞生成算法（permutation-based virtual cell generation algorithm），结合采样方案（sampling regime）和热力学后处理（thermodynamic post-processing），并利用神经网络加速物理性质预测。摘要未明确说明具体神经网络架构或第一性原理计算软件。

papers.title: Delineating the interplay effects of microstructure topology and residual stresses in ultrafast laser irradiated thin films
papers.abstract: Advanced nanodevices require high-precision machining of thin films using ultrafast lasers. However, thin-film fabrications cause variations in microstructure, crystallographic orientation, and residual stresses owing to coating conditions and substrate choice. This work investigates the complex interplay between these factors in ultrafast laser-irradiated gold (Au) thin films using a hybrid Two Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics simulations. We realized microstructure-informed atomistic models with varying grain topologies (randomized vs. equiaxed), grain sizes, and residual tensile/compressive stress configurations. Our results reveal a clear hierarchy of influence on laser-metal interaction: 1.) Microstructure configuration 2.) Topology 3.) Grain Size 4.) Crystallographic orientations. In fine-grained thin films, grain boundaries act as primary melting precursors, while local crystallographic orientation determines the melting extent in coarser grains. Residual tensile stresses contribute to higher melting and greater laser-induced expansion than unstrained films. Conversely, residual compressive stresses resist deformation, as deposited thermal energy is utilized to overcome lattice compression, leading to reduced expansion. We found that microstructure grain topology and size exert a stronger fingerprint on film expansion than the initial defect density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：hybrid Two Temperature Model-Molecular Dynamics simulations，混合双温模型-分子动力学模拟）；研究对象：超快激光辐照下的金（Au）薄膜，重点关注微观结构拓扑（随机取向 vs. 等轴晶）、晶粒尺寸、残余应力（拉伸/压缩）对激光-金属相互作用的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微观结构构型对激光-金属相互作用的影响具有明确层级：微观结构构型 > 拓扑 > 晶粒尺寸 > 晶体取向。残余拉伸应力促进熔化与膨胀，而残余压缩应力抑制膨胀；微观结构拓扑和尺寸对薄膜膨胀的影响比初始缺陷密度更显著。
