In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of sampling noise on VQDS, with a focus on ground-state preparation in one-dimensional Ising spin models using imaginary time evolution. We compare different regularization strategies for stabilizing the equations of motion and show that Tikhonov regularization provides robust performance in noisy imaginary-time evolution. We then benchmark measurement-distribution strategies that allocate shots by minimizing a cost function that characterizes the error in solving the equation of motion. Using noisy circuit simulations, we demonstrate that such optimized shot allocation can significantly improve state fidelity and reduce the total measurement cost by more than a factor of two compared to uniform shot distributions. We observe that the best results are found if a sufficiently large number of measurements is guaranteed for all circuits, suggesting that a finite fraction of shots should be distributed evenly. Our results provide practical guidelines for implementing measurement-efficient variational quantum dynamics and ground-state preparation on near-term quantum hardware.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：variational quantum dynamics simulations (VQDS)、noisy circuit simulations、regularization strategies。；研究对象：一维伊辛自旋模型（one-dimensional Ising spin models）的基态制备，具体通过虚时间演化（imaginary time evolution）实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在含噪变分量子动力学模拟中，Tikhonov正则化能稳健地稳定运动方程；通过优化测量次数分配（最小化运动方程求解误差的成本函数），可将态保真度显著提升，并将总测量成本降低至均匀分配方案的一半以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在含噪变分量子动力学模拟中，Tikhonov正则化能稳健地稳定运动方程；通过优化测量次数分配（最小化运动方程求解误差的成本函数），可将态保真度显著提升，并将总测量成本降低至均匀分配方案的一半以下。；创新点：系统研究了采样噪声对VQDS的影响，并提出了基于误差成本函数优化的测量分配策略，显著提升了测量效率；同时发现为保证最佳效果，所有电路应获得足够多的测量次数（即需保留一定比例的均匀分配测量次数）。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分量子动力学模拟（VQDS）框架，结合虚时间演化；对比了不同正则化策略（重点为Tikhonov正则化）；通过最小化表征运动方程求解误差的成本函数来优化测量次数分配（shot allocation），并使用含噪电路模拟进行基准测试。

papers.title: 2D GaSe-Based Single-Pixel Spectrometer via Electro-Optical Barrier Co-Modulation
papers.abstract: Driven by the growing demand for miniaturized spectrometers for in-situ analysis, and point-of-care diagnostics, conventional spectrometers are often constrained by bulky architectures and pathlength-limited spectral resolution. Achieving high-resolution, single-pixel computational spectrometers is therefore critical for the realization of compact, on-chip systems. Here, we report a single-pixel spectrometer enabled by a single 2D material; few-layer GaSe-based photodetector, in which the Schottky barrier height modulation, governed jointly by applied bias and optical excitation, provides an efficient mechanism for spectral encoding without the need for bulky dispersive elements. The device exhibits a high peak-wavelength accuracy of ~0.78 nm across a broad operational bandwidth (300-700 nm) within a compact footprint of ~100 um^2 and resolves closely spaced spectral features with separations down to ~5 nm. The device operates at low bias (+/- 4V) with an ultralow dark current density ~0.3 pA/um^2 at 4V bias. These results establish a simple, scalable route toward compact, cost-effective spectroscopic systems for on-chip spectral sensing and portable hyperspectral imaging applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report a single-pixel spectrometer enabled by a single 2D material; few-layer GaSe-based photodetector, the device exhibits, operates at。；研究对象：基于少层GaSe（硒化镓）二维材料的光电探测器，以及利用其构建的单像素光谱仪。具体物理现象为通过电学和光学协同调制实现的肖特基势垒高度变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用单个二维材料（少层GaSe）光电探测器，通过施加偏压和光激发共同调制肖特基势垒高度，实现了无需色散元件的单像素光谱仪，在紧凑的尺寸（~100 μm²）和宽波段（300-700 nm）内达到了~0.78 nm的峰值波长精度和~5 nm的光谱分辨能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用单个二维材料（少层GaSe）光电探测器，通过施加偏压和光激发共同调制肖特基势垒高度，实现了无需色散元件的单像素光谱仪，在紧凑的尺寸（~100 μm²）和宽波段（300-700 nm）内达到了~0.78 nm的峰值波长精度和~5 nm的光谱分辨能力。；创新点：提出了一种基于单一二维材料、通过电-光协同调制肖特基势垒来实现光谱编码的新机制，避免了传统光谱仪中笨重的色散元件（如光栅或棱镜），为实现紧凑、低成本、片上集成的光谱传感系统提供了一条简单、可扩展的路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法。具体包括：制备基于少层GaSe的光电探测器；通过施加偏压（±4V）和不同波长的光激发，协同调制器件的肖特基势垒高度，从而实现对光谱信息的编码；测量器件在不同偏压和光照下的光电响应，并利用算法重构光谱。

papers.title: Orbital-Angular-Momentum Entangled Photon Emission from Circular Currents in Semiconductor-Superconductor Structures
papers.abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that a superconducting circular current induced in a semiconductor results in emission of orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) entangled photon pairs upon carrier recombination. Combining the macroscopic Ginzburg-Landau theory and the microscopic Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) theory, we investigate the emission of a superconducting light-emitting diode (SLED) with a spatially varying phase profile in the superconducting order parameter. We show that in the active region of the SLED with a circular supercurrent, radiative recombination processes inherit the order parameter phase and result in photon pairs emitted into modes of different OAM quantum numbers. We demonstrate that coherent superposition of superconducting qubit eigenstates can also be mapped onto a coherent superposition of emitted photon states. We also show that other recombination processes due to thermally excited quasi particles do not significantly degrade the state purity. Our results introduce an original scheme for generating OAM-entangled photons enabling a new method of transmitting superconducting qubit information to photonic channels thereby bridging the gap between solid-state and photon-based platforms for quantum communications and information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretically demonstrate、investigate、show、introduce。；研究对象：半导体-超导体结构中的超导环形电流，以及由此产生的轨道角动量（OAM）纠缠光子对发射。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半导体-超导体结构中，超导环形电流诱导的载流子复合可以发射出轨道角动量纠缠的光子对；超导量子比特本征态的相干叠加可以映射到发射光子态的相干叠加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半导体-超导体结构中，超导环形电流诱导的载流子复合可以发射出轨道角动量纠缠的光子对；超导量子比特本征态的相干叠加可以映射到发射光子态的相干叠加。；创新点：提出了一种产生轨道角动量纠缠光子的原创方案，可将超导量子比特信息传输到光子通道，从而桥接固态与光子平台在量子通信与信息处理之间的鸿沟。
papers.method_zh: 结合宏观金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg-Landau）理论与微观BCS理论，研究具有超导序参量空间变化相位分布的超导发光二极管（SLED）中的光子发射过程。

papers.title: Poles-zeros duality in semi-holographic Mott insulators
papers.abstract: Inspired by the poles-zeros duality of Green's functions that appears in transitions into Mott-insulating phases in strongly correlated condensed matter systems, we propose a semi-holographic approach to Mott insulators. In this model, a fundamental fermion is coupled to a large-$N$, strongly interacting sector that generates a self-energy for the fundamental fermion's Green's function. This coupling amounts to a hybridization of the fundamental fermion with a strongly correlated fermionic composite. Within the holographic framework, at large $N$, the Green's function of the composite fermion naturally exhibits a poles-zeros duality. Zeros of the Green's function are caused by the poles of the self-energy that correspond to collective many-body excitations of the holographic strongly interacting sector. We calculate the spectral function of the fundamental fermion, from which we characterize the semi-holographic metallic and the Mott-insulating phases. In addition to the new physical interpretation of the zeros, our analysis yields a well-defined picture of the poles-zeros duality in terms of the freedom to choose between standard and alternative quantization in the strongly coupled sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出半全息模型（semi-holographic approach），基于大N展开和全息对偶框架进行理论分析。；研究对象：Mott绝缘体中的极点-零点对偶性（poles-zeros duality），具体研究强关联电子系统中从金属相到Mott绝缘相转变时格林函数的零点与极点结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在全息框架下，复合费米子的格林函数自然表现出极点-零点对偶性：格林函数的零点由自能的极点（对应全息强关联区的集体多体激发）引起。通过计算基本费米子的谱函数，可清晰区分半全息金属相与Mott绝缘相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在全息框架下，复合费米子的格林函数自然表现出极点-零点对偶性：格林函数的零点由自能的极点（对应全息强关联区的集体多体激发）引起。通过计算基本费米子的谱函数，可清晰区分半全息金属相与Mott绝缘相。；创新点：为格林函数的零点提供了新的物理诠释（由全息强关联扇区的集体激发自能极点导致），并利用强耦合扇区中标准/替代量子化的选择自由，给出了极点-零点对偶性的清晰图像。
papers.method_zh: 采用半全息方法（semi-holographic approach），将基本费米子与一个大N强关联全息扇区耦合，该扇区为基本费米子格林函数提供自能。耦合等价于基本费米子与强关联复合费米子的杂化。在全息框架下利用大N极限，并通过选择标准量子化或替代量子化来刻画极点-零点对偶性。

papers.title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
papers.abstract: Efficient discovery of precursor additives is essential for improving the performance of perovskite solar cells, yet the large chemical space makes conventional trial-and-error screening inefficient. We develop LEAP(LLM-driven Exploration via Active Learning for Perovskites), an expert-in-the-loop closed framework that couples a domain-specialized large language model(LLM) with active learning for iterative additive prioritization. The LLM is trained to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge from the perovskite additive literature and to represent candidate molecules through interpretable descriptors, which are further integrated into a Bayesian optimization workflow for uncertainty-aware prioritization under low-data conditions. Benchmark results on unseen literature show that the domain-specialized model outperforms general-purpose models in mechanism-consistent reasoning. Experimental validation in an expert-in-the-loop proof-of-concept study suggests improved additive prioritization across three screening rounds, leading to average device PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% for the later-round 6-CDQ- and 2-CNA-treated devices, respectively, compared with 19.25% for the control, with a champion PCE of 21.32%. These results provide preliminary evidence that literature-grounded mechanistic descriptors, when coupled with Bayesian optimization and expert feasibility review, can support mechanism-aware additive prioritization in perovskite photovoltaics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/机器学习）。判断依据：摘要中同时涉及“active learning”、“Bayesian optimization”等计算/机器学习方法，以及“experimental validation”、“device PCEs”等实验验证结果。；研究对象：钙钛矿太阳能电池的前驱体添加剂。具体体系为钙钛矿光伏器件，通过筛选前驱体添加剂来提升器件性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为LEAP的闭环框架，将领域专用大语言模型与贝叶斯优化相结合，能够在低数据条件下实现机制感知的前驱体添加剂优先排序。实验验证表明，该方法筛选出的添加剂（6-CDQ和2-CNA）使器件平均光电转换效率分别达到20.13%和20.87%，优于对照组的19.25%，冠军效率达21.32%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为LEAP的闭环框架，将领域专用大语言模型与贝叶斯优化相结合，能够在低数据条件下实现机制感知的前驱体添加剂优先排序。实验验证表明，该方法筛选出的添加剂（6-CDQ和2-CNA）使器件平均光电转换效率分别达到20.13%和20.87%，优于对照组的19.25%，冠军效率达21.32%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于：将文献驱动的机制描述符与贝叶斯优化及专家可行性审查相结合，构建了闭环的、机制感知的添加剂发现框架，而非传统的试错筛选。
papers.method_zh: 1）领域专用大语言模型（LLM）：从钙钛矿添加剂文献中提取机制相关知识，并通过可解释描述符表示候选分子；2）主动学习（Active Learning）与贝叶斯优化（Bayesian optimization）：在低数据条件下进行不确定性感知的添加剂优先排序；3）专家在环（expert-in-the-loop）实验验证：通过三轮筛选进行概念验证。

papers.title: Non-invertible Symmetries in Weyl Fermions, and Applications to Fermion-Boundary Scattering Problem
papers.abstract: We construct a family of non-invertible topological defects in two-dimensional theories of $n$ Weyl fermions. The construction relies on the existence of $G$-symmetric conformal boundary conditions for $n$ Dirac fermions. Upon unfolding, these boundary conditions become topological defects $\mathcal D$ of $n$ Weyl fermions that intertwine the two $G$-representations, and they are generically non-invertible. For $G=U(1)^n$, we show that $\mathcal D$ is a duality defect associated with gauging a finite Abelian group $Γ$, and we give an explicit algorithm for determining $Γ$ and its action on the fermions. We also show that the same finite-Abelian gauging description applies in certain restricted examples with non-Abelian $G$. By contrast, for certain non-Abelian symmetry structures, including the $G=SU(2)$ symmetry appearing in the $1$-$5$-$7$-$8$-$9$ problem, we prove that $\mathcal D$ cannot be realized as a duality defect for gauging any finite Abelian group. Finally, we explain how the duality-defect perspective gives a streamlined derivation of fermion scattering from a conformal boundary.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、topological defects（拓扑缺陷）、gauging（规范）、proof（证明）。；研究对象：二维Weyl费米子体系中的非可逆对称性，以及费米子与共形边界的散射问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了一族二维n个Weyl费米子理论中的非可逆拓扑缺陷，并证明对于某些非阿贝尔对称性（如SU(2)），该缺陷不能通过规范有限阿贝尔群来实现；同时揭示了该缺陷视角可简化费米子从共形边界散射的推导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了一族二维n个Weyl费米子理论中的非可逆拓扑缺陷，并证明对于某些非阿贝尔对称性（如SU(2)），该缺陷不能通过规范有限阿贝尔群来实现；同时揭示了该缺陷视角可简化费米子从共形边界散射的推导。；创新点：首次在Weyl费米子体系中系统构造了非可逆拓扑缺陷，并揭示了其与有限阿贝尔群规范对偶的关联及局限性，同时将该框架应用于费米子-边界散射问题的简化处理。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与证明。利用n个Dirac费米子的G-对称共形边界条件，通过“展开”（unfolding）过程将其转化为Weyl费米子中的拓扑缺陷；对于U(1)^n对称性，给出了确定有限阿贝尔群Γ及其作用的显式算法；对于非阿贝尔对称性，通过反证法证明缺陷无法由有限阿贝尔群规范实现。

papers.title: Anomalous Hall effect in anisotropic type-II Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: We extend our previous analysis [Phys. Rev. D 109, 065005 (2024)] of CPT-odd electromagnetic response in tilted, anisotropic Weyl semimetals to the overtilted (type-II) regime, where electron and hole pockets coexist at the Fermi level. Starting from the minimal QED sector of the Standard-Model Extension matched to a lattice-motivated anisotropic Dirac Hamiltonian with tilt, we compute the zero-temperature finite-density effective action nonperturbatively from the vacuum polarization tensor, and corroborate the result using a complementary chiral kinetic theory formulation that consistently incorporates both Fermi-sea and Fermi-surface contributions. In the type-II regime the unbounded linear dispersion necessitates a physical ultraviolet regularization. Implementing a hard momentum cutoff tied to the lattice bandwidth, we show that the CPT-odd, axion-like response remains finite across the type-I to type-II Lifshitz transition, while acquiring tilt- and anisotropy-dependent renormalizations together with nonuniversal, cutoff-sensitive terms governed by the geometry of the electron and hole pockets. As a concrete application, we evaluate the anomalous Hall conductivity in the prototypical type-II Weyl semimetal WTe$_2$, using parameters extracted from first-principles calculations and experiments, and find that Fermi-sea and Fermi-surface contributions are comparable and partially cancel, yielding a finite and strongly anisotropic Hall response characteristic of the overtilted regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“extend our previous analysis”“compute the effective action”“chiral kinetic theory formulation”。；研究对象：倾斜各向异性II型Weyl半金属中的反常霍尔效应，具体以WTe₂为原型材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在从I型到II型Weyl半金属的Lifshitz转变过程中，CPT奇异的轴子类电磁响应保持有限，但受到倾斜和各项异性依赖的重整化，并产生由电子和空穴口袋几何决定的非普适截断敏感项。在WTe₂中，费米海与费米面贡献大小相当且部分抵消，产生有限且强各向异性的霍尔响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在从I型到II型Weyl半金属的Lifshitz转变过程中，CPT奇异的轴子类电磁响应保持有限，但受到倾斜和各项异性依赖的重整化，并产生由电子和空穴口袋几何决定的非普适截断敏感项。在WTe₂中，费米海与费米面贡献大小相当且部分抵消，产生有限且强各向异性的霍尔响应。；创新点：将此前对倾斜各向异性Weyl半金属中CPT奇偶电磁响应的分析推广至过倾斜（II型）区域，并首次在具体材料WTe₂中定量评估了费米海与费米面贡献的竞争关系及反常霍尔电导的各向异性特征。
papers.method_zh: 基于标准模型扩展的最小QED扇区，匹配晶格驱动的各向异性倾斜Dirac哈密顿量，从真空极化张量非微扰地计算零温有限密度有效作用量；并用包含费米海和费米面贡献的手征动力学理论进行验证。采用与晶格带宽相关的硬动量截断实现紫外正则化。

papers.title: A Differentiable Measure of Algebraic Complexity: Provably Exact Discovery of Group Structures
papers.abstract: Discovering discrete algebraic rules from data is a fundamental challenge in machine learning. We formalize this problem through Cayley-table completion -- an algebraic counterpart to classical matrix completion -- where the degree of associativity violation replaces linear rank as the intrinsic measure of complexity. We provide a rigorous landscape analysis of HyperCube, an operator-valued tensor factorization, on the fully observed target table $δ$, proving that its global infimum $H_{\inf}(δ) := \inf_{Θ\in F_δ} H(Θ)$ implicitly defines an exact differentiable measure for this complexity. We show that HyperCube's native objective $H(Θ)$ decomposes into two components: geometric alignment (collinearity) and an inverse $\ell_2$ penalty. We establish that these continuous variational pressures induce core discrete properties: collinearity enforces associativity (Collinearity--Associativity Equivalence), and the inverse $\ell_2$ penalty reduces to an exact inverse rank penalty within the collinear manifold, driving the parameters toward full-rank unitarity. Consequently, we derive an absolute lower bound $H(Θ) \ge H_{\inf}(δ) \ge 3 \, |δ|$, where $|δ|$ is the target table size. We prove this absolute floor is attained if and only if the target is isotopic to a group, and characterize the global minimizer as the regular representation of the underlying group (up to unitary gauge), resolving the central open conjecture of Huh (2025). This work serves as an existence proof that certain discrete algebraic structures can be exactly characterized by differentiable measures, enabling gradient-based discovery without the need for combinatorial search. All theoretical results are mechanically verified in Lean 4 and confirmed via small-scale experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：landscape analysis、provably exact、differentiable measure、gradient-based discovery）；研究对象：离散代数结构（群结构）的机器学习发现与表征问题，具体通过Cayley表补全任务形式化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明HyperCube张量分解的目标函数H(Θ)的全局下确界H_inf(δ)隐式定义了一个精确可微的代数复杂度度量，且该下界在且仅在目标表同构于一个群时达到，从而实现了对群结构的可微、可梯度优化的精确发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明HyperCube张量分解的目标函数H(Θ)的全局下确界H_inf(δ)隐式定义了一个精确可微的代数复杂度度量，且该下界在且仅在目标表同构于一个群时达到，从而实现了对群结构的可微、可梯度优化的精确发现。；创新点：首次证明离散代数结构（群）可以被连续可微的度量精确刻画，从而无需组合搜索即可通过梯度下降发现群结构；解决了Huh (2025)的核心公开猜想。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对算子值张量分解模型HyperCube进行严格的景观分析，将目标函数分解为几何对齐（共线性）项和逆ℓ2惩罚项，并证明共线性-结合性等价定理以及逆ℓ2惩罚在共线性流形内退化为精确的逆秩惩罚。所有理论结果在Lean 4中机械验证，并辅以小规模数值实验。

papers.title: Band Structure and topology of a periodically deformed Kitaev honeycomb model
papers.abstract: Motivated by the growing interest in spin liquids and topological phases, as well as the rise of deformation engineering, we study the combined effects of deformation and magnetic fields on the honeycomb Kitaev model. The Kitaev model, as one of the prototypical and exactly solvable spin liquid-hosting models, serves as a simple platform that demonstrates the rich physics one can expect at the intersection of deformation physics and quantum spin liquids. Our work builds on a simplified solution to the undeformed base model that we present. This simplified solution allows for a straightforward extension of our analysis to the deformed case. After incorporating periodic deformations into the Kitaev model (chosen for its similarity to moiré physics), we investigate the effects of a hexagonally symmetric deformation on the band structure. We find that deformation leads to a smaller Brillouin zone with new band gaps at the edges, indicating the potential for topological transitions. Finally, we introduce a magnetic field to break time-reversal symmetry and thereby allow for non-trivial topology. We find that, under specific parameter conditions, the magnetic field leads to multiple band-gap closings and openings. An investigation into topological properties reveals nontrivial Chern numbers and a plethora of topological transitions. Our results suggest possible thermal Hall or Nernst-type responses. We also suggest a potential bulk measurement approach for he Chern numbers and possible path to physical realization. Most importantly, our results serve as a demonstration of the rich phenomenology that can arise due to the interplay between deformation and spin-liquid physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究”、“分析”、“揭示”等理论推导和计算分析词汇，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：周期性变形的蜂窝状Kitaev模型，以及外加磁场对该模型能带结构和拓扑性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 周期性变形导致布里渊区缩小并在边界出现新的能隙，暗示可能发生拓扑相变；外加磁场在特定参数条件下引起多次能隙闭合与重新打开，并产生非平庸的陈数和丰富的拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：周期性变形导致布里渊区缩小并在边界出现新的能隙，暗示可能发生拓扑相变；外加磁场在特定参数条件下引起多次能隙闭合与重新打开，并产生非平庸的陈数和丰富的拓扑相变。；创新点：将变形工程（类似莫尔物理）与Kitaev自旋液体模型相结合，系统研究了变形与磁场共同作用下的能带拓扑变化，并提出了可能的陈数体测量方法及物理实现路径。
papers.method_zh: 基于Kitaev模型的精确可解性，提出一种简化解法，并将其推广至周期性变形情形；通过分析六角对称变形下的能带结构，并引入磁场破坏时间反演对称性，研究拓扑性质（如陈数）。

papers.title: Controlled expansion for correlated electrons with concentrated kinematics
papers.abstract: We introduce a systematic expansion tailored to systems with strong local interactions and capable of computing response functions, including finite DC transport, analytically. The expansion is controlled by a small parameter $s^2$ that measures the area of the momentum space region where kinematics of the theory is concentrated. In real space, this corresponds to single-particle or correlated hopping terms with amplitudes that decay over a length scale $1/s$ and scale in magnitude as $s^2$ in two dimensions. In the limit $s^2\ll 1$, long, self-avoiding tunneling paths dominate over paths revisiting the same site. This enables systematic controlled calculations of various physical quantities. We illustrate the method with three applications. (i) A Hubbard model with concentrated dispersion: we analytically obtain spectral broadening which scales as $s^2$ and identify a high-temperature bad metal with $T$-linear resistivity coexisting with parametrically long-lived quasiparticles, as well as an intermediate-temperature "thermal FL*" with a small hole pocket that coexists with thermally disordered fluctuating local moments, all within a single controlled framework. (ii) A correlated-hopping model with interesting electron-trion dynamics. (iii) A model of Chern bands with concentrated Berry curvature, motivated by twisted bilayer graphene, which realizes a Mott semimetal where we compute the broadening for the electron and trion spectral functions. At the end, we discuss how our approach paves the way to addressing various challenging questions in strongly correlated systems and outline its various generalizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：controlled expansion、analytically、systematic expansion、theoretical framework。；研究对象：强关联电子系统，具体包括：(i) 具有集中色散的Hubbard模型；(ii) 具有电子-三子动力学的关联跳跃模型；(iii) 具有集中贝里曲率的Chern能带模型（受扭曲双层石墨烯启发）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入了一个由小参数 \( s^2 \) 控制的系统化展开方法，可在强局域相互作用体系中解析计算响应函数（包括有限直流输运）。在 \( s^2 \ll 1 \) 极限下，长程自回避隧穿路径主导物理过程，从而实现对多种物理量的可控计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入了一个由小参数 \( s^2 \) 控制的系统化展开方法，可在强局域相互作用体系中解析计算响应函数（包括有限直流输运）。在 \( s^2 \ll 1 \) 极限下，长程自回避隧穿路径主导物理过程，从而实现对多种物理量的可控计算。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该方法的核心创新在于利用“运动学集中”这一几何特征（动量空间区域小）作为小参数，使得在强关联体系中仍能进行系统化、可控的解析计算，并能在同一框架内同时描述高温坏金属、中间温度热FL*相以及电子-三子动力学等复杂现象。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一种基于动量空间区域面积（由 \( s^2 \) 度量）的受控展开方法。在实空间中，该方法对应于单粒子或关联跳跃项，其振幅在二维空间中按 \( 1/s \) 尺度衰减，大小按 \( s^2 \) 标度。通过分析自回避隧穿路径的贡献，实现了对谱函数、电阻率等物理量的解析计算。

papers.title: Towards a Matrix Product Ansatz in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: Matrix product ansatz (MPA) is a powerful framework for constructing exact steady state weights of one dimensional non-equilibrium stochastic processes; but its generalization to higher dimensions is limited. Here, we introduce the MPA formalism for two dimensions (2D). As a concrete application, we introduce and exactly solve a non-conserved assisted exclusion model (NAEM) in one and two dimensions with constrained hopping and local birth-death dynamics: a particle can hop to a neighbouring site only when exactly one of its neighbouring sites is vacant, while creation and annihilation occur exclusively at sites whose neighbours are all occupied. The MPA yields exact steady-state weights and provides a systematic method to compute observables such as density moments and particle currents. In the particle-conserving limit, the system undergoes an absorbing phase transition at the critical density $ρ_c=\frac12$ with order-parameter exponent $β=3$. We further show that the steady state of the NAEM maps exactly onto the well-studied hard-square lattice gas with nearest-neighbour exclusion, thereby providing a nonequilibrium dynamical route to realizing equilibrium states of constrained lattice gases. Our work generalizes matrix-product methods beyond one dimension, establishing a systematic approach to exact solutions of interacting stochastic systems in 2D.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Matrix product ansatz (MPA)、exact steady state weights、non-equilibrium stochastic processes。；研究对象：二维非平衡随机过程，具体为一种具有约束跳跃和局域生灭动力学的非守恒辅助排斥模型（NAEM），以及其与硬方格气体模型的映射关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作将矩阵乘积拟设（MPA）推广到二维，并精确求解了二维非守恒辅助排斥模型（NAEM）的稳态权重；在粒子守恒极限下，系统在临界密度ρ_c=1/2处发生吸收相变，序参量指数β=3。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作将矩阵乘积拟设（MPA）推广到二维，并精确求解了二维非守恒辅助排斥模型（NAEM）的稳态权重；在粒子守恒极限下，系统在临界密度ρ_c=1/2处发生吸收相变，序参量指数β=3。；创新点：将原本主要用于一维非平衡过程的矩阵乘积方法推广到二维，为精确求解二维相互作用随机系统提供了系统化方法。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：矩阵乘积拟设（MPA）形式体系，用于构造二维非平衡随机过程的精确稳态权重；通过映射将NAEM的稳态与具有最近邻排斥的硬方格气体模型精确对应。

papers.title: Probing tunable Kerr nonlinearity in graphene Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: Josephson junction (JJ) is a key nonlinear element in superconducting devices such as qubits, amplifiers, and bolometers. Recently, gate-tunable JJs based on graphene and semiconductors have gained interest due to their rich Andreev physics and wide applications in circuit quantum electrodynamics devices. In addition to gate tunability, it offers many advantages over conventional JJs, such as exceptional thermal properties for bolometric sensors, magnetic-field compatibility, and operability at elevated temperatures above 1 K. Like conventional Al-AlOx-Al JJs, graphene JJs also act as nonlinear inductors, and at their heart lies the Kerr nonlinearity. Additionally, in graphene JJs, the nonlinearity is tunable via external knobs in a single device. However, a detailed exploration of the tunable Kerr nonlinearity in graphene JJs has never been performed. In this work, we study the dependence of the Kerr nonlinearity on gate voltage, temperature, and DC bias - an interesting knob that has been less explored. Using these parameters, we show that the magnitude of the Kerr coefficient can be tuned over a wide range, from 300 kHz to 1.2 MHz. Our work will be a valuable resource for further understanding of the nonlinearity in graphene JJs and for the design of next-generation amplifiers and sensors, with enhanced performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we study the dependence of the Kerr nonlinearity on gate voltage, temperature, and DC bias”，并给出了具体的实验测量结果（Kerr系数从300 kHz到1.2 MHz可调）。；研究对象：石墨烯约瑟夫森结（graphene Josephson junctions）中的可调谐Kerr非线性（Kerr nonlinearity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节栅压、温度和直流偏置，石墨烯约瑟夫森结的Kerr系数可以在300 kHz到1.2 MHz的宽范围内连续调谐，其中直流偏置是一个此前较少被探索的有效调控手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节栅压、温度和直流偏置，石墨烯约瑟夫森结的Kerr系数可以在300 kHz到1.2 MHz的宽范围内连续调谐，其中直流偏置是一个此前较少被探索的有效调控手段。；创新点：首次详细探索了石墨烯约瑟夫森结中Kerr非线性的可调谐性，特别是系统研究了直流偏置这一此前较少被关注的调控参数对非线性的影响。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了石墨烯约瑟夫森结中Kerr非线性对栅压、温度和直流偏置的依赖关系，通过分析Kerr系数的变化来表征非线性强度。

papers.title: Itinerant Nature of Spin-Density-Wave Order in Ruddlesden-Popper Nickelates
papers.abstract: The nature of magnetism in layered Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates remains a central open question, particularly in light of recent observations of spin-wave-like magnetic excitations in metallic multilayer compounds. Here, we develop a unified itinerant description of spin-density-wave (SDW) order and magnetic excitations in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ and La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. The essential ingredient is the multilayer mirror structure of the NiO$_2$ blocks, which organizes the low-energy electronic states into mirror-even and mirror-odd sectors. We show that dominant interband nesting between mirror-opposite bands drives a mirror-selective itinerant SDW instability, whose collective modes naturally reproduce the experimentally observed spin-wave-like spectra. In La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$, the SDW further induces a secondary mirror-even charge density wave, yielding intertwined spin and charge textures. Our results demonstrate that magnetism in multilayer nickelates is fundamentally itinerant rather than local-moment in origin, and establish mirror-selective interband SDW order as a unifying organizing principle for magnetic correlations in these systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“develop a unified itinerant description”、“We show that”、“Our results demonstrate”等表述，核心是建立理论模型和物理图像，而非报道新的实验数据或计算结果。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper 镍氧化物（具体为 La₃Ni₂O₇ 和 La₄Ni₃O₁₀）中的自旋密度波（SDW）序及其磁激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多层镍氧化物中的磁性本质上是巡游（itinerant）的，而非局域磁矩起源。其自旋密度波序是由镜面对称性相反的能带之间的带间嵌套驱动的“镜面选择性”巡游SDW不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多层镍氧化物中的磁性本质上是巡游（itinerant）的，而非局域磁矩起源。其自旋密度波序是由镜面对称性相反的能带之间的带间嵌套驱动的“镜面选择性”巡游SDW不稳定性。；创新点：提出了“镜面选择性带间SDW序”作为理解多层镍氧化物磁关联的统一组织原则，并指出在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中，该SDW序会进一步诱导出次级镜面偶电荷密度波，形成交织的自旋与电荷纹理。这从根本上将磁性起源归为巡游电子，而非局域磁矩。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。构建了一个统一的巡游电子图像，关键要素是NiO₂块层的多层镜面结构，该结构将低能电子态划分为镜面偶和镜面奇两个扇区。基于此，分析了能带嵌套驱动的SDW不稳定性及其集体激发模式。

papers.title: Relativistic Saturation of Coulomb-Limited Electron Coherence
papers.abstract: We show that the non-relativistic theory of mutual coherence and localization in Coulomb-disordered media can be extended to relativistic electron beams used in transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Starting from the Dirac equation, we derive a paraxial Schrödinger-like equation for the envelope spinor and obtain an effective coupling constant $A_{\rm rel}=(γ+1)/(2γ\hbar v)$ that governs the disorder-induced phase fluctuations. In the non-relativistic limit $γ\to1$ this reduces to $1/(\hbar v)$, while for ultra-relativistic electrons it saturates at $1/(2\hbar c)$. The universal relation between the transverse coherence length $ρ_c$ and the single-particle localization length $\ell$, namely $ρ_c\simλ_D\sqrt{\ell/L}$, remains unchanged. We compare the asymptotic behaviour of the phase structure function $D_φ(ρ)$ and the localization length in the non-relativistic and relativistic regimes, and show that the emergent algebraic decay of mutual coherence at large separations, analogous to the wave-structure-function asymptotics in turbulent media, persists in both cases. The results imply that standard TEM energies (100--300~keV) are already close to the optimal regime for minimizing Coulomb decoherence, and that further increasing the beam energy yields diminishing returns. While the asymptotic coherence decay is algebraic rather than exponential, the corresponding exponent can still be large for realistic experimental parameters, so the effect is primarily of conceptual and asymptotic significance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：从Dirac方程出发推导解析表达式，未提及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：库仑无序介质中相对论电子束的互相干性与局域化现象，具体针对透射电子显微镜（TEM）中的电子束。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非相对论理论中电子相干长度的关系可推广至相对论电子束，且有效耦合常数在超相对论极限下饱和为1/(2ℏc)；标准TEM能量（100–300 keV）已接近最小化库仑退相干的最优区间，进一步提高束能收益递减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非相对论理论中电子相干长度的关系可推广至相对论电子束，且有效耦合常数在超相对论极限下饱和为1/(2ℏc)；标准TEM能量（100–300 keV）已接近最小化库仑退相干的最优区间，进一步提高束能收益递减。；创新点：首次将库仑无序介质中电子互相干与局域化的非相对论理论系统推广至相对论电子束，并揭示相对论效应对耦合常数的饱和效应；指出TEM常用能量已处于优化库仑退相干的近最优区域。
papers.method_zh: 从Dirac方程出发，推导包络旋量的近轴类薛定谔方程，得到有效耦合常数A_rel的解析表达式；对比非相对论与相对论区域相位结构函数D_φ(ρ)和局域化长度的渐近行为。

papers.title: Finite-temperature spin diffusion in the two-dimensional XY model
papers.abstract: We present a combined theory-experiment study to quantify spin diffusion in the square lattice quantum spin-1/2 XY model at finite temperature. On the theory side, we leverage a recently developed dynamical high-temperature expansion method to faithfully capture the long spatiotemporal scales of the hydrodynamic regime. Experimental results are obtained from an optical lattice hard-core boson quantum simulator. The excellent agreement of spin diffusion constants marks a breakthrough in spin-transport beyond one dimension and for the quantitative validation of state-of-the-art quantum simulation platforms. We also provide theory predictions for future experiments on dynamic spin conductivity or anisotropy-induced integrability breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论与实验结合）。关键词：combined theory-experiment study、theory side、experimental results、quantum simulator。；研究对象：二维正方晶格量子自旋-1/2 XY模型在有限温度下的自旋扩散现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 理论计算与光学晶格量子模拟实验得到的自旋扩散常数高度一致，标志着自旋输运研究突破一维限制，并定量验证了先进量子模拟平台的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：理论计算与光学晶格量子模拟实验得到的自旋扩散常数高度一致，标志着自旋输运研究突破一维限制，并定量验证了先进量子模拟平台的有效性。；创新点：首次在二维体系中实现自旋扩散常数的定量理论与实验对比，并提供了未来动态自旋电导率或各向异性诱导可积性破缺实验的理论预测。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：采用近期发展的动力学高温展开方法（dynamical high-temperature expansion method），捕捉流体力学区域的长时空尺度行为。实验方面：使用光学晶格硬核玻色子量子模拟器。

papers.title: Diffusive-to-Ballistic transition in a Persistent Random Walk
papers.abstract: We study persistent random walk with time dependent velocity reversal probabilities and identify a criterion for a non-equilibrium dynamical transition. As a representative example, we consider a power law reversal probability $p(t)\sim t^{-α}$ and show that the system undergoes a transition at $α=1$, separating a super-diffusive regime for $α<1$ from ballistic regime for $α\geq 1$. Using the results for velocity correlations and persistence statistics, together with finite time scaling of the Binder cumulant and displacement fluctuations, we characterize the transition and its properties in detail. We further argue that the transition is not limited to the power law form, but can also arise for several other time dependent reversal probabilities satisfying the same criterion. The transition persists in arbitrary spatial dimensions provided isotropy of the velocity space is preserved.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：persistent random walk（持续随机游走）、dynamical transition（动力学转变）、scaling（标度分析）。；研究对象：持续随机游走模型，具体研究具有时间依赖速度反转概率的非平衡动力学系统，重点分析幂律反转概率 p(t)~t^{-α} 下的扩散-弹道转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统在 α=1 处发生非平衡动力学转变：当 α<1 时为超扩散区，当 α≥1 时为弹道区。该转变不限于幂律形式，只要满足特定判据的其他时间依赖反转概率也可引发类似转变，且在保持速度空间各向同性的任意空间维度中均存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统在 α=1 处发生非平衡动力学转变：当 α<1 时为超扩散区，当 α≥1 时为弹道区。该转变不限于幂律形式，只要满足特定判据的其他时间依赖反转概率也可引发类似转变，且在保持速度空间各向同性的任意空间维度中均存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析计算：利用速度关联函数、持久性统计量、Binder累积量的有限时间标度以及位移涨落等统计工具，刻画转变特征。

papers.title: Lattice thermal conductivity decomposition: Peierls vs. non-Peierls contributions
papers.abstract: The Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivity computed using the full classical heat current of a crystalline solid is compared with results obtained from the quadratic component of the heat current and from the commonly used Peierls heat current. In addition, thermal conductivity within the relaxation time approximation is evaluated. Three crystalline systems are investigated: solid argon, a model of solid argon with alternating masses, and $α$-quartz. For all materials considered, the thermal conductivities calculated using the quadratic and Peierls heat currents differ only slightly. In the case of $α$-quartz, the optical phonon contribution to the thermal conductivity is found to exceed that of the acoustic modes. The relaxation time approximation systematically underestimates the thermal conductivity in all three systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivity、relaxation time approximation、classical heat current。；研究对象：晶格热导率的分解，具体研究三种晶体体系：固体氩、交替质量固体氩模型、α-石英。核心物理现象是热输运中Peierls贡献与非Peierls贡献的区分。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 使用二次热流和Peierls热流计算的热导率差异很小；在α-石英中，光学声子对热导率的贡献超过声学模式；弛豫时间近似在所有三种体系中均系统性低估热导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：使用二次热流和Peierls热流计算的热导率差异很小；在α-石英中，光学声子对热导率的贡献超过声学模式；弛豫时间近似在所有三种体系中均系统性低估热导率。；创新点：系统比较了全热流、二次热流和Peierls热流三种方法计算晶格热导率的差异，并揭示了光学声子在α-石英中主导热导率这一反直觉现象。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用经典分子动力学结合Green-Kubo公式计算全热流、二次热流分量以及常用的Peierls热流对应的晶格热导率，并利用弛豫时间近似（RTA）评估热导率。

papers.title: Spin polarization enhancement in a single-layer Bi(1-x)Sb(x) alloy on Ag(111) via isovalent substitution
papers.abstract: Co-adsorption of Bi and Sb on Ag(111) at room temperature yields a single-layer Bi(1-x)Sb(x) alloy with a rectangular 3xsqrt(3) structure containing four atoms per unit cell (2/3 ML total coverage) and lacking long-range chemical order. We present an electronic structure study of this system combining angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and density functional theory (DFT) calculations. To investigate the effect of inversion symmetry breaking induced by substituting a heavier atom (Bi) with a lighter isoelectronic one (Sb) within a fixed crystallographic framework, we focused on a Bi-rich composition. ARPES measurements reveal four surface-state bands, in good agreement with DFT calculations based on a rectangular four-atom overlayer unit cell. DFT calculations further show that Sb incorporation induces both in-plane and out-of-plane asymmetries in the electronic potential, leading to sizable spin splitting and spin polarization of the overlayer bands. Although these effects are partially reduced by interaction with the substrate, they remain significant. Our work illustrates, through a concrete model system, a general principle: incorporating a lighter isovalent element can significantly enhance spin polarization, potentially offering a useful design guideline for understanding and engineering Rashba-related systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)”和“density functional theory (DFT) calculations”。；研究对象：在Ag(111)表面生长的单层Bi(1-x)Sb(x)合金薄膜，具体研究其电子结构及等价位取代（用较轻的Sb替换较重的Bi）对自旋极化的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单层Bi(1-x)Sb(x)合金中，用较轻的等价位元素Sb替代Bi，会引入面内和面外的电势不对称性，从而显著增强合金能带的自旋劈裂和自旋极化。尽管与衬底的相互作用会部分削弱这一效应，但增强效果依然显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单层Bi(1-x)Sb(x)合金中，用较轻的等价位元素Sb替代Bi，会引入面内和面外的电势不对称性，从而显著增强合金能带的自旋劈裂和自旋极化。尽管与衬底的相互作用会部分削弱这一效应，但增强效果依然显著。；创新点：通过一个具体的模型体系，阐明了一个普适原理：在固定晶体结构框架下，引入较轻的等价位元素可以显著增强自旋极化，为理解和设计Rashba相关体系提供了新的设计思路。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量电子能带结构；理论上采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Spectral and transmission properties of multiple correlated quantum dots made simple
papers.abstract: Steady-state density functional theory, called i-DFT, is employed to compute spectral and transmission properties of general interacting nanoscale regions coupled to electronic reservoirs. Exchange-correlation functionals are constructed for different interactions and coupling geometries. The potential of the method is illustrated by applications to various multiple quantum dots from the Coulomb blockade to the Kondo regime, capturing phenomena such as quantum phase transitions. The results are in excellent agreement with many-body approaches at a fraction of the computational cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：steady-state density functional theory (i-DFT)、exchange-correlation functionals、many-body approaches。；研究对象：多个相互关联的量子点（multiple correlated quantum dots）构成的纳米尺度区域，耦合到电子库（electronic reservoirs），涵盖从库仑阻塞（Coulomb blockade）到近藤效应（Kondo regime）的输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于稳态密度泛函理论（i-DFT）的方法能够以极低的计算成本，准确计算多量子点体系的谱函数和透射性质，并捕捉量子相变等复杂现象，结果与多体方法高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于稳态密度泛函理论（i-DFT）的方法能够以极低的计算成本，准确计算多量子点体系的谱函数和透射性质，并捕捉量子相变等复杂现象，结果与多体方法高度一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用稳态密度泛函理论（i-DFT），针对不同相互作用和耦合几何构造交换关联泛函（exchange-correlation functionals），用于计算一般相互作用纳米区域的谱和透射性质。

papers.title: Coherent terahertz magnon-phonon three-wave mixing in a layered antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: The coherent nonlinear dynamics between collective excitations, such as magnons and phonons, drive emergent phenomena in quantum materials, yet their direct observation remains a central challenge. Here, using double-terahertz-pump optical-probe spectroscopy, we report the direct observation of coherent magnon-phonon three-wave mixing in the layered antiferromagnetic insulator FePS$_{3}$. We resolve both second- and third-order nonlinear responses of antiferromagnetic magnons and identify a suite of nonlinear couplings in two-dimensional (2D) coherent spectra, including definitive sum- and difference-frequency generation between magnons and phonons. These results lay the groundwork for exploiting coherent nonlinearities to entangle magnetic and vibrational excitations, opening avenues for quantum control and hybrid quantum technologies in the terahertz regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：double-terahertz-pump optical-probe spectroscopy（双太赫兹泵浦光探针光谱学）、direct observation（直接观测）、2D coherent spectra（二维相干光谱）。；研究对象：层状反铁磁绝缘体 FePS₃ 中的磁振子（magnon）与声子（phonon）之间的相干非线性动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 FePS₃ 中直接观测到了磁振子与声子之间的相干三波混频过程，包括明确的合频与差频产生，并解析了反铁磁磁振子的二阶和三阶非线性响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 FePS₃ 中直接观测到了磁振子与声子之间的相干三波混频过程，包括明确的合频与差频产生，并解析了反铁磁磁振子的二阶和三阶非线性响应。；创新点：首次在实验上直接观测到磁振子与声子之间的相干三波混频，为利用相干非线性实现磁与振动激发的纠缠以及太赫兹波段的量子控制与混合量子技术奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 双太赫兹泵浦光探针光谱学（double-terahertz-pump optical-probe spectroscopy），结合二维相干光谱（2D coherent spectra）分析非线性耦合。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium quantum dynamics of interacting integrable models by Monte Carlo sampling Lehmann representations
papers.abstract: Determining the dynamics of interacting integrable many-particle quantum systems at finite times after homogeneous quantum quenches is a long-standing challenge. We present a Monte Carlo sampling scheme that numerically evaluates the Lehmann representation for time-dependent expectation values of local operators, allowing us to access system sizes and times significantly beyond the reach of existing methods. The approach accommodates both the full Lehmann sum and the Quench Action formalism. We benchmark against exact results for non-interacting lattice and continuum models and short-time results at weak interactions, finding excellent agreement. We apply the method to quantum quenches from a Bose-Einstein condensate in the repulsive Lieb-Liniger model and determine the time evolution of the order parameter for a wide range of interaction strengths. We discuss the emergence of a "sign problem" for more general dynamical correlators and setups.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Monte Carlo sampling、Lehmann representation、数值计算。；研究对象：可积多粒子量子系统在均匀量子淬火后的非平衡动力学，具体以排斥型Lieb-Liniger模型中的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体为应用案例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于蒙特卡洛采样的数值方案，能够有效计算局域算符含时期望值的Lehmann表示，从而在系统尺寸和时间尺度上显著超越现有方法，并成功应用于Lieb-Liniger模型从BEC初始态淬火后的序参量时间演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于蒙特卡洛采样的数值方案，能够有效计算局域算符含时期望值的Lehmann表示，从而在系统尺寸和时间尺度上显著超越现有方法，并成功应用于Lieb-Liniger模型从BEC初始态淬火后的序参量时间演化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛采样方法数值计算Lehmann表示中的求和，兼容完整Lehmann求和与淬火作用形式；通过与无相互作用晶格/连续模型精确解及弱相互作用短时结果对比进行基准测试。

papers.title: Secondary Collective Excitations in Intermediate to Strong-Coupling Superconductors
papers.abstract: Considering systematically derived energy-transfer-dependent effective electron-electron interactions leads to the appearance of secondary phase and amplitude modes in isotropic superconductors in the intermediate-to-strong-coupling regime. We study the implications of such interactions on Bravais lattices by computing the corresponding response functions using the iterated equations of motion (iEoM) approach. In the weak-coupling regime, we find the conventional, primary amplitude and phase modes at $ω=2Δ$ and $ω=0$, respectively. For intermediate coupling, the amplitude mode detaches from the quasiparticle continuum towards lower energies. Increasing the coupling further leads to additional, long-lived secondary collective excitations below the continuum. This phenomenon is largely independent of the underlying lattice and the specific Fermi level. The amplitude and phase modes couple if the system is not particle-hole symmetric. Additionally, we extend the method to compute eigenoperators, i.e., linear combinations of operators that excite each secondary mode specifically. We identify nodal structures in the coefficients for these eigenoperators reminiscent of wave functions in the Hydrogen problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“系统推导”、“计算响应函数”、“iEoM方法”等理论计算与分析关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：各向同性超导体在中等至强耦合区间的次级集体激发（振幅模与相位模），以及这些激发在Bravais晶格上的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中等至强耦合超导体中，除了传统的初级振幅模（ω=2Δ）和相位模（ω=0）外，还会出现额外的、长寿命的次级集体激发，且该现象对晶格类型和费米能级不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中等至强耦合超导体中，除了传统的初级振幅模（ω=2Δ）和相位模（ω=0）外，还会出现额外的、长寿命的次级集体激发，且该现象对晶格类型和费米能级不敏感。；创新点：首次在中等至强耦合各向同性超导体中预言了次级集体激发的存在，并发现其本征算符系数具有类似氢原子波函数的节点结构。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用迭代运动方程（iEoM）方法，基于系统推导的依赖于能量转移的有效电子-电子相互作用，计算响应函数，并进一步计算本征算符以识别各次级模的激发方式。

papers.title: Vortex order in magnetic frustrated GeNi$_2$O$_4$ and GeCo$_2$O$_4$ spinels
papers.abstract: In the search for new spin textures based on singular magnetic objects like Bloch-points or vortices, spinel compounds emerge as an interesting playground due to the interplay between magnetic anisotropy and complex interactions that extend well beyond first neighbors on a pyrochlore lattice. Based on an exploration of the exchange interaction phase diagrams of members of the Ge$B_2$O$_4$ family with $B$=Co and Ni, we show, using simultaneous modeling of inelastic neutron scattering measurements and single-crystal neutron diffraction data, that a 2-$k$ magnetic structure may be stabilized in these compounds. This leads to a short period spin vortex crystal, a variant induced by the magnetic anisotropy of the 3-$k$ Bloch-point structure predicted for isotropic spins. Our study rationalizes the formation of these multi-$k$ spin textures in frustrated antiferromagnets, as well as their anisotropy-dependent evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：同时涉及非弹性中子散射测量、单晶中子衍射实验数据，以及交换相互作用相图的理论建模。；研究对象：磁性尖晶石化合物 GeNi₂O₄ 和 GeCo₂O₄ 中的涡旋序（vortex order）及多-k 自旋纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时建模非弹性中子散射和单晶中子衍射数据，发现 GeNi₂O₄ 和 GeCo₂O₄ 中可稳定存在一种 2-k 磁结构，形成短周期自旋涡旋晶体。该结构是各向异性诱导的变体，源于各向同性自旋系统中 3-k 布洛赫点结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时建模非弹性中子散射和单晶中子衍射数据，发现 GeNi₂O₄ 和 GeCo₂O₄ 中可稳定存在一种 2-k 磁结构，形成短周期自旋涡旋晶体。该结构是各向异性诱导的变体，源于各向同性自旋系统中 3-k 布洛赫点结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非弹性中子散射测量、单晶中子衍射实验，结合交换相互作用相图的理论探索与建模。

papers.title: Spin Response Properties in Electronically Robust Ferromagnetic Strained $\text{CrSiSe}_3$ Monolayer under External Electric Fields
papers.abstract: Integrating two-dimensional van der Waals magnets into field-effect spintronic devices requires robust charge stability and tunable spin responses. In this study, we investigate the electronic, topological, magnonic, and magneto-optical properties of the strain-engineered ferromagnetic $\text{CrSiSe}_3$ monolayer under out-of-plane external electric fields by using first-principles calculations. We find that for this material, the intrinsic charge sector, including the indirect band gap, charge Berry curvature, optical conductivities, and magneto-optical Kerr effect spectra, exhibits exceptional robustness against applied fields up to 0.3 V/$Å$. Conversely, the spin degrees of freedom demonstrate highly sensitive tunability. Electrostatic gating significantly modulates the spin Berry-like curvature, driving a non-monotonic enhancement in the spin Hall conductivity. Furthermore, external fields effectively tune collective magnon excitations by modifying microscopic Heisenberg exchange interactions. Such coexistence of robust charge immunity and flexible spin manipulation establishes the strained $\text{CrSiSe}_3$ monolayer as a promising platform for stable spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：应变工程下的铁磁单层CrSiSe₃（铬硅硒）在外加垂直电场下的自旋响应特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变CrSiSe₃单层中，电荷自由度（如带隙、贝里曲率等）对外加电场（高达0.3 V/Å）表现出极强的鲁棒性，而自旋自由度（如自旋霍尔电导、磁振子激发）则展现出高度灵敏且可调的特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变CrSiSe₃单层中，电荷自由度（如带隙、贝里曲率等）对外加电场（高达0.3 V/Å）表现出极强的鲁棒性，而自旋自由度（如自旋霍尔电导、磁振子激发）则展现出高度灵敏且可调的特性。；创新点：发现了在单一材料体系中同时实现“电荷免疫”与“自旋灵活调控”的独特性质，为设计稳定的自旋电子学器件提供了新平台。摘要未突出说明与已有应变CrSiSe₃研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）。具体分析了电子结构、拓扑性质、磁振子（magnon）性质以及磁光性质（如磁光克尔效应）。

papers.title: Tunable magnetotransport through kinetically hindered first-order phase transitions in an antiferromagnetic metal
papers.abstract: Controllable multilevel resistance states are of interest for memory technologies like neuromorphic computing, but robust materials platforms toward such behavior remain limited. Here, we show that the non-centrosymmetric antiferromagnetic metal CeCoGe$_3$ suggests one such route through a kinetically hindered first-order magnetic transition. Cooling through the kinetically hindered first-order transition in an applied magnetic field produces a magnetic glass state in which high- and low-temperature magnetic phases coexist. The relative fraction of these phases can be controlled by the applied field in which the sample is cooled, and the electrical resistance is directly sensitive to that fraction. As a result, it is demonstrated that CeCoGe$_3$ supports stable multilevel resistive states. These results identify kinetically hindered first-order phase transitions as a promising route towards controllable multilevel magnetoresistive states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrated、electrical resistance、magnetotransport。；研究对象：非中心对称反铁磁金属CeCoGe₃中的一级磁相变及其动力学阻碍行为，以及由此产生的多级电阻态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过磁场冷却过程中动力学阻碍的一级磁相变，CeCoGe₃可形成高、低温磁相共存的磁玻璃态，其相比例可通过外加磁场调控，从而实现稳定的多级电阻态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过磁场冷却过程中动力学阻碍的一级磁相变，CeCoGe₃可形成高、低温磁相共存的磁玻璃态，其相比例可通过外加磁场调控，从而实现稳定的多级电阻态。；创新点：提出利用动力学阻碍的一级相变作为实现可控多级磁电阻态的新途径，为神经形态计算等存储技术提供了材料平台。摘要未突出说明与已有反铁磁多级电阻材料的性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 在施加磁场的条件下对样品进行冷却，测量电阻随温度/磁场的变化，通过电阻对磁相比例的敏感性表征多级电阻态。

papers.title: Geometry-Dependent Crack Interaction and Toughening in Graphene
papers.abstract: The interaction between neighboring cracks has been shown to strongly influence the fracture behavior of graphene. While previous studies focused primarily on crack spacing, the role of crack width remains poorly understood. Here, computational simulations are performed to investigate the coupled effects of crack width and inter-crack spacing $(W_\text{gap})$ on the tensile response of graphene containing parallel cracks. The results show that increasing crack width amplifies the sensitivity of mechanical properties to crack spacing, leading to significant enhancement of peak stress, fracture strain, and toughness at sufficiently large $W_\text{gap}$. For narrow cracks, crack coalescence dominates and causes brittle failure. In contrast, wider cracks promote delayed ligament rupture, increased energy absorption and ductile-like fracture behavior. The normalized toughness and fracture strain exceed those of equivalent single-crack systems by more than twofold. A crack-geometry design map is proposed to identify regimes of crack coalescence, independent propagation, and enhanced toughness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：computational simulations、tensile response。；研究对象：石墨烯中平行裂纹的几何构型（裂纹宽度与间距）对断裂行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 增大裂纹宽度会放大力学性能对裂纹间距的敏感性，在足够大的裂纹间距下，峰值应力、断裂应变和韧性显著增强；宽裂纹可诱发延性断裂行为，使归一化韧性和断裂应变超过等效单裂纹系统的两倍以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：增大裂纹宽度会放大力学性能对裂纹间距的敏感性，在足够大的裂纹间距下，峰值应力、断裂应变和韧性显著增强；宽裂纹可诱发延性断裂行为，使归一化韧性和断裂应变超过等效单裂纹系统的两倍以上。；创新点：首次系统研究了裂纹宽度与间距的耦合效应，并提出了基于裂纹几何构型的设计图谱，用于区分裂纹合并、独立扩展和韧性增强三种断裂模式。
papers.method_zh: 计算模拟（computational simulations），具体方法摘要未明确说明（如分子动力学、有限元等）。

papers.title: Mesoscale Domain Evolution Mechanism during Alternating Current (AC) Poling of Relaxor Ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric domain variants that are energetically equivalent are expected to remain preserved during polarization reversal under a symmetry-preserving electric field. However, recent experiments on relaxor-ferroelectric crystals have revealed irreversible elimination of inclined domain walls during AC poling, while the underlying mesoscale mechanism remains unclear. Here, we investigate the domain-wall motion during AC poling of rhombohedral Pb(Mg$_{1/3}$Nb$_{2/3}$)O$_3$--PbTiO$_3$ single crystals containing both 71$^\circ$ and 109$^\circ$ domain walls within a quasi-two-dimensional laminated geometry using phase-field simulations. The simulations reveal that the domain-wall behavior during polarization reversal depends on the spacing ratio between the 71$^\circ$ and 109$^\circ$ domain walls. Closely spaced 71$^\circ$ domain walls undergo irreversible elimination, whereas more widely separated walls are preserved, while the 109$^\circ$ domain walls remain intact. A threshold ratio for domain-wall elimination is identified and found to depend on the mechanical boundary conditions. By tracking the domain-wall trajectories during the switching process, we attribute this behavior to unsynchronized motion of neighboring 71$^\circ$ domain walls arising from long-range elastic interactions when the walls become strongly coupled. This collective motion breaks the symmetry between energetically equivalent domain variants and leads to irreversible domain-wall elimination during polarization reversal. These findings provide mechanistic insight into collective domain-wall evolution during polarization reversal and suggest that proximity-driven symmetry breaking may provide a mesoscale mechanism for domain engineering in ferroelectric materials with high domain-wall densities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：phase-field simulations）；研究对象：弛豫铁电体Pb(Mg₁/₃Nb₂/₃)O₃–PbTiO₃单晶中71°和109°畴壁在交流极化过程中的介观演化机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交流极化过程中，相邻71°畴壁的间距比决定了其是否被不可逆消除：间距较小时因长程弹性相互作用导致运动不同步，破坏对称性，引发畴壁不可逆消除；间距较大时畴壁得以保留，109°畴壁则始终完整。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交流极化过程中，相邻71°畴壁的间距比决定了其是否被不可逆消除：间距较小时因长程弹性相互作用导致运动不同步，破坏对称性，引发畴壁不可逆消除；间距较大时畴壁得以保留，109°畴壁则始终完整。；创新点：揭示了交流极化下畴壁不可逆消除的介观机制——邻近71°畴壁因强耦合导致的集体运动不同步，并提出了基于间距比的阈值条件，为高畴壁密度铁电材料的畴工程提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 相场模拟（phase-field simulations），针对准二维层状几何结构中的菱方相单晶，包含71°和109°两种畴壁。

papers.title: Ellipticity effects on diffusive magnon spin and heat transport in easy-plane ferromagnets
papers.abstract: When a magnetic material hosts spin-wave excitations, or magnons, the local magnetization can rotate in circular or elliptical orbits, the latter arising naturally in the presence of magnetic anisotropies transverse to the equilibrium magnetization. This article investigates the diffusive transport of elliptical magnons in easy-plane ferromagnets. Our analysis starts with the derivation of the magnon dispersion relation and magnon spin from the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation with a perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Then, using the Boltzmann transport equation in the relaxation time approximation and perturbation analysis, the magnon-spin and magnon thermal conductivities are obtained, quantifying the magnon transport in the insulator. Our calculations demonstrate that, in both three- and two-dimensional systems, the effects of ellipticity on magnon transport coefficients result in an enhancement or a decrease, depending on whether magnets with a easy or hard perpendicular-to-plane axis are considered, respectively. On the other hand, our results predict an enhancement of the magnon heat transport for both easy- and hard-axis magnetic systems. Our study supports previous works on magnon ellipticity and makes a step towards clarifying its effect on magnon transport properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derivation of the magnon dispersion relation”“Boltzmann transport equation”“perturbation analysis”等理论推导方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：易平面铁磁体中椭圆偏振磁振子（elliptical magnons）的扩散输运行为，具体研究磁振子自旋和热输运系数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 椭圆度对磁振子输运系数的影响取决于垂直磁各向异性的类型：对于易轴垂直于平面的磁体，椭圆度增强输运；对于难轴垂直于平面的磁体，椭圆度抑制输运。而磁振子热输运在两种情况下均被增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：椭圆度对磁振子输运系数的影响取决于垂直磁各向异性的类型：对于易轴垂直于平面的磁体，椭圆度增强输运；对于难轴垂直于平面的磁体，椭圆度抑制输运。而磁振子热输运在两种情况下均被增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程推导磁振子色散关系和磁振子自旋；采用弛豫时间近似下的玻尔兹曼输运方程结合微扰分析，计算磁振子自旋电导率和热导率。

papers.title: Adaptive Slater Koster Parameters: Crossing Oxidation States with Density Functional Tight Binding
papers.abstract: We propose to adapt the confined pseudo-atomic orbitals underpinning the precalculated Slater-Koster (SK) interaction tables in Density Functional Tight Binding (DFTB) to local atomic environments. We demonstrate significant improvement in electronic structure and energetics in the application to a partially oxidized Ni surface and Li insertion into graphite, where we assign optimal SK parameters to metal atoms in different oxidation states. Further analysis reveals the smoothness of the SK integrals across the varying oxidation states. Exploiting this, we introduce a site-resolved machine-learning scheme for fully adaptive DFTB. Using atomic descriptors and simple regression architectures already established in the context of machine-learning interatomic potentials, our scheme achieves 95% band-structure accuracy across all Ni-O binary compositions in the Materials Project.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Density Functional Tight Binding (DFTB)、machine-learning、Slater-Koster parameters。；研究对象：部分氧化的Ni表面、Li嵌入石墨体系，以及Ni-O二元化合物。核心是研究不同氧化态下金属原子的电子结构与能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将Slater-Koster积分参数自适应地匹配局部原子环境（特别是不同氧化态），可显著提升DFTB方法在部分氧化Ni表面和Li嵌入石墨中的电子结构与能量精度；进一步利用SK积分随氧化态平滑变化的特性，结合机器学习实现了全自适应DFTB，在Materials Project中所有Ni-O二元组分上达到95%的能带结构精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将Slater-Koster积分参数自适应地匹配局部原子环境（特别是不同氧化态），可显著提升DFTB方法在部分氧化Ni表面和Li嵌入石墨中的电子结构与能量精度；进一步利用SK积分随氧化态平滑变化的特性，结合机器学习实现了全自适应DFTB，在Materials Project中所有Ni-O二元组分上达到95%的能带结构精度。；创新点：首次提出将预计算的Slater-Koster相互作用表根据局部原子环境（尤其是氧化态）进行自适应调整，并利用SK积分随氧化态平滑变化的特性，结合机器学习实现全自动参数化，显著提升了DFTB在复杂化学环境下的精度。
papers.method_zh: 采用自适应约束赝原子轨道方法，为不同氧化态的金属原子分配最优Slater-Koster参数；引入基于原子描述符和简单回归架构的位点分辨机器学习方案，实现全自适应DFTB。

papers.title: PEPSKit.jl: A Julia package for projected entangled-pair state simulations
papers.abstract: We present PEPSKit.jl, a Julia package for simulating two-dimensional quantum many-body systems with infinite projected entangled-pair states (iPEPS). PEPSKit.jl builds on the TensorKit.jl package for tensor computations and provides high-level algorithms for iPEPS simulations that support both Abelian and non-Abelian symmetries, as well as fermionic systems. This work gives an overview of the main package features, which include support for ground-state, time-evolution, and finite-temperature simulations in systems with different physical symmetries and lattice geometries. These capabilities are illustrated through various examples and technical benchmarks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Julia package、simulations、projected entangled-pair state。；研究对象：二维量子多体系统，具体为无限投影纠缠对态（iPEPS）模拟方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个新的数值模拟软件包PEPSKit.jl的功能和性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要介绍了一个新的数值模拟软件包PEPSKit.jl的功能和性能。；创新点：提供了一个支持多种对称性（阿贝尔、非阿贝尔）和费米子系统的通用Julia语言iPEPS模拟框架，并集成了基态、时间演化和有限温度等多种模拟能力。
papers.method_zh: 基于TensorKit.jl张量计算库，开发了支持阿贝尔与非阿贝尔对称性以及费米子系统的iPEPS模拟算法，包括基态、时间演化和有限温度模拟。

papers.title: Self-Decelerating Bright Exciton-Polariton Solitons in Bound-State-in-Continuum Microcavities
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the formation and dynamics of bright exciton-polariton solitons within systems engineered to support Bound States in the Continuum. By employing a driven-dissipative Gross-Pitaevskii equation coupled with a rate equation for the excitonic reservoir, we demonstrate that BICs provide a robust platform for stabilizing the condensate against radiative decay. Utilizing a Lagrangian variational approach, we derive analytical expressions describing the trajectory and velocity of these bright solitonic excitations. Notably, we find that the propagation of these BIC-engineered solitons exhibits a distinct self-deceleration, eventually bringing them to a halt at a final position dictated by the initial conditions and intrinsic system parameters. Furthermore, we analyze the dynamical stability of these solitons. Our findings offer valuable insights into the manipulation of polaritonic flows in non-Hermitian systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“derive analytical expressions”、“analyze the dynamical stability”。；研究对象：基于连续谱束缚态（Bound States in the Continuum, BIC）微腔中的亮激子-极化激元孤子（bright exciton-polariton solitons）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BIC工程化的亮激子-极化激元孤子在传播过程中表现出独特的自减速行为，最终会停止在由初始条件和系统内禀参数决定的位置。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BIC工程化的亮激子-极化激元孤子在传播过程中表现出独特的自减速行为，最终会停止在由初始条件和系统内禀参数决定的位置。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用驱动-耗散型Gross-Pitaevskii方程耦合激子库的速率方程进行理论建模，并利用拉格朗日变分方法推导孤子轨迹和速度的解析表达式。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian thermoelectric transport in graphene: Tunable anomalous transmission through complex barriers
papers.abstract: We investigate thermoelectric transport in monolayer graphene across a finite complex barrier within a Landauer scattering framework. Solving the Dirac-Weyl problem exactly, we show that the imaginary part of the barrier renders the scattering matrix nonunitary and replaces the usual Hermitian flux conservation by a generalized flux-balance relation determined by the net gain or loss inside the barrier. In the Hermitian limit, the standard graphene $n$-$p$-$n$ barrier behavior is recovered, including perfect transmission at normal incidence and Fabry-Perot-type resonances. For a finite imaginary part, however, the same resonant channels are selectively attenuated or amplified, which significantly modifies both the angular response and the conductance profile. We further show that the lead-resolved conductances become dependent on the bias partition, providing a direct signature of the breakdown of gauge invariance in the effective two-terminal response. At finite temperature, the exact linear-response coefficients reveal a clear trade-off controlled by the imaginary part of the barrier: gain enhances both the electrical and thermal conductances, whereas loss suppresses the thermal conductance more efficiently and yields the largest thermoelectric figure of merit within the parameter range considered. These results demonstrate that complex barriers extend the range of transport behaviors accessible in graphene beyond the usual Hermitian $n$-$p$-$n$ junction. They also suggest a practical interpretation of the imaginary potential as an effective reduced description of unresolved source-sink channels or additional probes coupled to the device, particularly when a fully microscopic model of the environment is not available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Landauer scattering framework”“exact solution of Dirac-Weyl problem”“linear-response coefficients”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：单层石墨烯中通过有限复杂势垒（复势垒）的热电输运现象，具体为n-p-n结结构中的非厄米输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复势垒的虚部使散射矩阵非幺正，导致不同共振通道被选择性放大或衰减，从而显著改变角度响应和电导谱；在有限温度下，增益增强电导和热导，而损耗更高效地抑制热导，并在所考虑参数范围内获得最大热电优值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复势垒的虚部使散射矩阵非幺正，导致不同共振通道被选择性放大或衰减，从而显著改变角度响应和电导谱；在有限温度下，增益增强电导和热导，而损耗更高效地抑制热导，并在所考虑参数范围内获得最大热电优值。；创新点：将非厄米势垒引入石墨烯热电输运研究，揭示了复势垒虚部对共振通道的选择性调控机制，并指出虚势可有效描述未解析的源-漏通道或额外探测耦合的简化模型。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landauer散射框架，精确求解Dirac-Weyl方程，推导非厄米势垒下的散射矩阵与广义流平衡关系，并计算线性响应系数（电导、热导、热电优值）。

papers.title: Realization of a parity-violating antiferromagnetic state in LaMnSi
papers.abstract: Spontaneous symmetry breaking underlies functional electronic phenomena in quantum materials. Breaking space-inversion ($\mathcal{P}$) or time-reversal ($\mathcal{T}$) symmetry can generate spin-split electronic bands central to modern spintronics. By contrast, parity-violating antiferromagnetic (AFM) order breaks both $\mathcal{P}$ and $\mathcal{T}$ while preserving the combined $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, enabling spin-degenerate yet momentum-asymmetric electronic bands. This momentum asymmetry has been proposed as a microscopic origin of unconventional nonreciprocal and nonlinear responses but its experimental verification has remained challenging because it requires establishing both the symmetry-breaking magnetic order and the associated electronic structure. Here we combine soft x-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and polarization-resolved optical second-harmonic generation (SHG) microscopy to study LaMnSi, a candidate parity-violating AFM metal. Soft x-ray ARPES resolves the three-dimensional bulk band structures in agreement with density functional theory calculations for the AFM phase, whereas SHG microscopy detects sign-reversing nonlinear optical responses from opposite AFM domains that carry $\mathcal{T}$-odd parity-violating order. Together, these results provide direct evidence for parity-violating AFM state in LaMnSi, establish LaMnSi as a parity-violating AFM metal, and identify this class of AFMs as a promising platform for symmetry-controlled nonreciprocal and nonlinear electronic responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了结合软X射线角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和偏振分辨光学二次谐波发生（SHG）显微镜的实验手段，并给出了实验观测结果。；研究对象：LaMnSi，一种候选的宇称破坏反铁磁金属。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实验证实了LaMnSi中存在宇称破坏的反铁磁态，该态同时打破空间反演对称性（\(\mathcal{P}\)）和时间反演对称性（\(\mathcal{T}\)），但保持联合\(\mathcal{PT}\)对称性，从而产生自旋简并但动量不对称的电子能带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实验证实了LaMnSi中存在宇称破坏的反铁磁态，该态同时打破空间反演对称性（\(\mathcal{P}\)）和时间反演对称性（\(\mathcal{T}\)），但保持联合\(\mathcal{PT}\)对称性，从而产生自旋简并但动量不对称的电子能带。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）解析三维体相能带结构，并结合偏振分辨光学二次谐波发生（SHG）显微镜探测来自相反反铁磁畴的非线性光学响应。实验数据与密度泛函理论（DFT）计算结果进行了对比。

papers.title: Twisted light generates robust many-body states for practical quantum computing
papers.abstract: Twisted light carries orbital angular momentum (OAM) and can drive excitations of confined, interacting electrons that are dark to uniform dipolar probes. Here we show how this ``beyond-Kohn's-Theorem'' optical channel can become a concrete control primitive for quantum computing. Correlation sectors in few-electron quantum dots -- characterized by the relative angular momentum quantum number -- form a tunable ladder of many-body states that are robust in the limited sense of symmetry-protected selection rules and persistent chiral spectroscopic fingerprints; full topological gap protection requires three or more electrons. A twisted-light pulse with prescribed OAM index and polarization provides fast optical write, read, and scalable addressing of these sectors via the selection rule $Δ|m|=\pm(l+σ)$. In the analytically solvable Calogero ($1/r^2$) interaction limit, both the energy spectrum and the twisted-light matrix elements are closed-form functions of the interaction strength, allowing gate parameters (Rabi frequency, qubit frequency, anharmonicity, and leakage rates) to be written down explicitly. We map these results onto a universal single-qubit gate set, propose a concrete two-qubit entangling mechanism via state-dependent Coulomb coupling between adjacent dots, and identify the dominant decoherence channel (quadrupolar charge noise). A semi-analytic $N=3$ extension using the $1/N$ expansion provides a design-level scaffold for the topological roadmap, including quasihole sector addressing. The central operational message is that twisted light enables WRITE (pulse-create a correlation sector), READ (spectroscopically diagnose correlations), and SCALE (optical addressing via spatial light modulator) in a unified photonic control layer. Throughout, screened and Coulomb interactions preserve the same qualitative chiral fingerprints established in the solvable limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“show”“map”“propose”“identify”等理论推导和模型构建词汇，未提及实验数据或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：少电子量子点中的多体关联态，特别是由相对角动量量子数表征的关联扇区，以及利用扭曲光（携带轨道角动量）对其进行操控的量子计算方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 扭曲光可通过选择定则Δ|m|=±(l+σ)实现对量子点中多体关联态的高速光学写入、读取和可扩展寻址，这些关联态在对称性保护选择定则和手性光谱特征意义上具有鲁棒性；在可解Calogero相互作用极限下，可显式写出量子门参数，并映射到通用单量子比特门集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：扭曲光可通过选择定则Δ|m|=±(l+σ)实现对量子点中多体关联态的高速光学写入、读取和可扩展寻址，这些关联态在对称性保护选择定则和手性光谱特征意义上具有鲁棒性；在可解Calogero相互作用极限下，可显式写出量子门参数，并映射到通用单量子比特门集。；创新点：首次将扭曲光这一“超越Kohn定理”的光学通道具体转化为量子计算的控制原语，实现了统一的光子控制层中WRITE、READ、SCALE三大操作，并给出了从单量子比特门到双量子比特纠缠及拓扑路线图的设计框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用超越Kohn定理的扭曲光-电子耦合通道，基于相对角动量量子数构建多体态阶梯；在Calogero（1/r²）相互作用可解极限下解析求解能谱和矩阵元；采用1/N展开进行N=3半解析扩展；提出基于态依赖库仑耦合的双量子比特纠缠机制；识别四极电荷噪声为主退相干通道。

papers.title: Percolation of a cohesive fine particle in a static bed
papers.abstract: Percolation of fine particles (fines) in a static bed of larger particles is central to many industrial and natural processes. Non-cohesive fines either pass through the bed or become trapped depending on multiple factors including particle sizes, friction and restitution coefficients, and size-polydispersity. Here we consider the additional factor of cohesion. We use the discrete element method to simulate gravity-driven percolation of cohesive fine particles through a static bed of randomly packed large particles; fines interact with bed particles but not with each other. A large-to-fine particle diameter ratio of 7 geometrically permits non-cohesive fines to pass the narrowest pore throats formed by the large particles so they can freely percolate. However, sufficiently large cohesion and friction lead to non-geometric trapping. Fines are trapped when they fail to rebound after a collision, due to large cohesion, low restitution, and low collision velocity, and any subsequent rolling or sliding is insufficient to cause detachment. This establishes a sequence of local interactions -- collision, adhesion, and post-contact motion -- that governs the ultimate fate of a fine particle. A collisional model that incorporates a trapping probability per collision and a collision frequency predicts the trapping distance in the regime dominated by collision-induced trapping. For non-rebounding collisions, frictional effects are enhanced by cohesion and, when large enough, prevent the fine particle from subsequently detaching. A static equilibrium condition based on force balance predicts whether a fine particle remains stationary after contact. These results show that percolation of cohesive fine particles is not determined by geometric accessibility alone, but also by particle-scale interaction dynamics that can override geometric expectations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“discrete element method (DEM)”（离散元法）、“simulate”（模拟）。；研究对象：粘性细颗粒在静态大颗粒床中的渗流（percolation）现象。具体研究的是重力驱动下，单个粘性细颗粒穿过随机堆积的大颗粒床层的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粘性细颗粒的渗流不仅取决于几何因素（如粒径比），更取决于颗粒尺度的相互作用动力学。即使几何上允许通过，足够大的粘聚力和摩擦力也会导致细颗粒被非几何性地捕获。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粘性细颗粒的渗流不仅取决于几何因素（如粒径比），更取决于颗粒尺度的相互作用动力学。即使几何上允许通过，足够大的粘聚力和摩擦力也会导致细颗粒被非几何性地捕获。；创新点：该工作首次系统地研究了**粘聚力**（cohesion）这一额外因素对细颗粒渗流的影响，揭示了在几何上允许通过的情况下，粘聚力和摩擦力如何通过改变颗粒尺度的碰撞和接触动力学，导致非几何性的捕获，从而超越了传统仅考虑几何可达性的理解。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散元法（Discrete Element Method, DEM）进行数值模拟。模拟中，细颗粒与床层颗粒相互作用，但细颗粒之间无相互作用。通过分析碰撞、粘附、接触后运动等一系列局部相互作用，并结合基于碰撞概率和频率的碰撞模型以及基于力平衡的静态平衡条件来预测捕获行为。

papers.title: Ground-state Entropy of the Ising model on a Frustrated lattice
papers.abstract: We report the ground-state entropy of a 2-d Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice. We also study a generalization of this model, where a constraint on the zero temperature allowed configurations is removed continuously.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“report the ground-state entropy”（报告基态熵）、“study a generalization”（研究推广模型），属于统计物理模型的理论分析。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的二维Ising模型，这是一个典型的受挫（frustrated）晶格系统。物理现象是受挫晶格在零温下的基态简并度（即基态熵）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文报告了Shastry-Sutherland晶格上Ising模型的基态熵，并研究了通过连续移除零温允许构型约束后该模型的推广行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文报告了Shastry-Sutherland晶格上Ising模型的基态熵，并研究了通过连续移除零温允许构型约束后该模型的推广行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体创新点。主要贡献在于首次报告了该特定受挫晶格上Ising模型的基态熵，并引入了一种连续调控约束的推广模型。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如转移矩阵法、蒙特卡洛模拟或解析求解），仅提及对模型进行了“generalization”（推广）并“continuously removed”（连续移除）约束条件。具体技术细节需阅读全文。

papers.title: Geometric curvature driven by many-body collective fluctuations
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry characterizes the variation of wavefunctions in momentum space through their overlaps and relative phases, providing a general framework for understanding many transport and optical properties. It is generally formulated in terms of interband matrix elements, which, entering the response functions, allow obtaining experimental access to the quantum geometric tensor. Recently, it has been emphasized that quantum geometry can also be interpreted in terms of quantum dipole fluctuations in the ground state driven by interband mixing. Here, we extend this picture to include contributions from many-body collective fluctuations, in which propagators and response vertices are dressed dynamically by the interaction with collective modes. Focusing on the Berry curvature, we show that contributions from collective fluctuations can be experimentally distinguished from bare band-geometric contributions, via specific antisymmetric channels in inelastic scattering spectra. We further identify the non-commutative properties of transverse quantum fluctuations as well as non-local-time interactions as the generators of this dynamical curvature in the susceptibility response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：quantum geometry, theoretical framework, susceptibility response。；研究对象：多体集体涨落驱动的几何曲率（Berry curvature），具体关注量子几何张量在集体激发（如集体模式）下的动态修正。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 集体涨落对Berry曲率的贡献可通过非弹性散射谱中的特定反对称通道与裸能带几何贡献区分开；横向量子涨落的非对易性质以及非定域时间相互作用是这种动力学曲率在响应函数中的生成机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：集体涨落对Berry曲率的贡献可通过非弹性散射谱中的特定反对称通道与裸能带几何贡献区分开；横向量子涨落的非对易性质以及非定域时间相互作用是这种动力学曲率在响应函数中的生成机制。；创新点：将量子几何的“量子偶极涨落”图像从单粒子能带混合扩展到多体集体涨落，揭示了集体模式如何动态修饰几何曲率，并提出了实验区分裸几何与集体几何贡献的谱学判据。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子几何的涨落-耗散理论框架，通过引入由集体模式动态修饰的传播子和响应顶点，推导出包含多体集体涨落贡献的Berry曲率表达式，并分析其在非弹性散射谱中的可观测特征。

papers.title: Partially reactive force field for the UiO-66 metal-organic framework
papers.abstract: UiO-66 is the most widely studied metal-organic framework (MOF), on account of its structural tunability given by its capacity of sustaining high amounts of point defects in its structure. Its synthesis mechanism is largely unknown, with only a few works mostly focused on the formation of the Zr-oxide cluster. In this work, a partially reactive force field to model UiO-66, nb-UiO-FF, is introduced. This force field incorporates node--ligand reactivity via a Morse potential and the introduction of dummy atoms to reproduce the anisotropic charge distribution of the Zr atoms in the node. nb-UiO-FF reproduces structural features of both UiO-66 and its isoreticular analog UiO-67, mechanical properties and framework stability with or without defects, activated or filled with N,N-dimethylformamide or ethanol. The force field is further employed within a molecular dynamics scheme to study the early stages of solvothermal node--ligand binding. Transient structural motifs both thermodynamically and kinetically favored are identified. This force field enables studying the self-assembly of UiO-66, as well as the formation of its point defects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“force field”（力场）、“molecular dynamics”（分子动力学）、“model”（建模）。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOF）材料UiO-66及其等网状类似物UiO-67，特别是其节点-配体结合过程及点缺陷的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一个名为nb-UiO-FF的部分反应力场，该力场能够准确再现UiO-66和UiO-67的结构特征、力学性质以及在不同状态（有/无缺陷、活化或填充溶剂）下的框架稳定性。通过分子动力学模拟，识别出了在溶剂热节点-配体结合早期阶段中，热力学和动力学上有利的瞬态结构基元。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一个名为nb-UiO-FF的部分反应力场，该力场能够准确再现UiO-66和UiO-67的结构特征、力学性质以及在不同状态（有/无缺陷、活化或填充溶剂）下的框架稳定性。通过分子动力学模拟，识别出了在溶剂热节点-配体结合早期阶段中，热力学和动力学上有利的瞬态结构基元。；创新点：提出了一个能够同时描述UiO-66结构、力学性质以及节点-配体反应性的力场，从而使得研究该MOF的自组装过程和点缺陷形成成为可能。摘要未突出说明与已有力场相比的具体性能提升细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用部分反应力场（Partially reactive force field）进行建模，该力场通过Morse势描述节点-配体反应性，并引入虚拟原子（dummy atoms）来再现节点中Zr原子的各向异性电荷分布。力场验证后，进一步用于分子动力学（Molecular dynamics）模拟。

papers.title: Building a Regional Data-Centric Materials Science Ecosystem for Processing-Rich Materials Innovation in the Great Plains
papers.abstract: Data-centric materials science is changing how materials are discovered, optimized, manufactured, and qualified, yet many deployment-limiting materials problems still depend on experimental, processing-rich, device-level, and field-relevant data that are difficult to capture in conventional materials databases. This perspective argues that the Great Plains and adjacent interior research corridor can make a distinctive national contribution by organizing distributed experimental assets into a trusted regional materials-data ecosystem. The proposed model emphasizes FAIR metadata, provenance, persistent sample identifiers, uncertainty-aware modeling, semi-closed-loop workflows, stackable workforce training, and tiered governance for academic, public, controlled-access, and industry-protected data. We identify five coupled barriers -- fragmented data, weak algorithm--laboratory translation, uneven access to cyberinfrastructure and technical staff, workforce gaps at the materials--data interface, and insufficient incentives for sharing and reuse -- and propose a staged roadmap for addressing them. A high-purity germanium pilot illustrates how regional strengths can be converted into reusable datasets, benchmark models, trained personnel, and decision-improving workflows. The broader message is that regional leadership in data-centric materials science will depend less on geographic concentration than on trustworthy data practices, interoperable infrastructure, cross-trained people, and application-driven materials challenges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（观点/综述性文章，结合数据科学框架与实验案例）。判断依据：关键词“perspective argues”、“proposed model”、“pilot illustrates”。；研究对象：摘要未明确说明单一具体材料或物理现象。研究对象为“数据驱动的材料科学”生态系统，并以“高纯锗（high-purity germanium）”作为示范案例，涉及材料发现、优化、制造与认证的全流程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出具体物理结论。核心观点是：通过构建区域性的可信材料数据生态系统（强调FAIR元数据、溯源、样本标识、不确定性建模等），美国大平原及相邻内陆研究走廊可在处理密集型材料创新中做出独特的国家贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出具体物理结论。核心观点是：通过构建区域性的可信材料数据生态系统（强调FAIR元数据、溯源、样本标识、不确定性建模等），美国大平原及相邻内陆研究走廊可在处理密集型材料创新中做出独特的国家贡献。；创新点：提出将分散的实验资产组织成区域性的、以数据为中心的材料科学生态系统，并系统识别了五大耦合障碍（数据碎片化、算法-实验室转化弱、网络基础设施与技术人员分布不均、材料-数据界面人才缺口、共享与复用激励不足），同时给出了分阶段路线图。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未涉及具体实验或计算方法。提出的框架包括：FAIR元数据管理、溯源追踪、持久样本标识、不确定性感知建模、半闭环工作流、可堆叠劳动力培训、分级数据治理（学术/公共/受控/工业保护）。案例中提及“高纯锗”作为试点，但未说明具体表征或计算手段。

papers.title: Function, Complexity and Thermodynamics in Adaptive and Intelligent Soft Matter Systems: An Information-Theoretical Formulation
papers.abstract: The terms responsive, adaptive and intelligent are widely used in soft matter but inconsistently defined. This paper formulates them as information channels of increasing architectural complexity: a memoryless map p(y|x) (responsive), a state-conditioned map p(y|x,s) (adaptive), and a feedback-modified channel p(y_t|x_t, X_past, Y_past) (intelligent). Existing complexity metrics for cross-class comparison fail at least one of: dimensional consistency, common reference, thermodynamic coupling, scale-bridging. Three information-theoretic metrics are proposed: configurational diversity I1, Hazen functional selectivity I2, and stimulus-response information transfer I3. Treating the material as the channel yields a complexity-function relationship: internal complexity raises potential information capacity but also raises attenuation and dissipation. This implies a thermodynamic scaling ceiling and an optimal internal complexity N* set by transmission efficiency, stimulus energy and thermal noise (a Carnot-analogue limit). A benchmarking framework compares synthetic soft matter, biological systems and hard-matter architectures in common information coordinates. Ten representative systems are mapped on the volumetric rate (I3 per unit volume) versus power density plane. They form four bands above the Landauer floor: 10^18 to 10^20 for soft matter and shape-memory alloys; 10^10 to 10^16 for silicon digital and electromechanical; 10^9 to 10^10 for memristor neuromorphic; 10^5 to 10^8 for evolved biology (all uncertain to at least one order of magnitude). The mechanistic origin of the gap between synthetic soft matter and biology is the per-element substrate energy scale (1 to 10 kBT versus 10^4 to 10^5 kBT). Three architectural routes - feedback, multi-channel orthogonality, and molecular memory - are proposed to let soft matter populate this gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“information-theoretical formulation”（信息论公式化）、“metrics are proposed”（提出度量标准）、“implies a thermodynamic scaling ceiling”（暗示热力学标度上限），全文以理论推导和概念构建为主。；研究对象：响应性、自适应性和智能软物质系统。具体研究这些系统在信息处理架构上的复杂性、功能与热力学之间的定量关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个基于信息论的统一框架，将软物质系统的响应性、自适应性和智能性定义为不同复杂度的信息通道。发现内部复杂度与功能之间存在权衡：增加复杂度会提升潜在信息容量，但也会增加信号衰减和能量耗散，从而存在一个由传输效率、刺激能量和热噪声决定的最优内部复杂度（类似卡诺极限）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个基于信息论的统一框架，将软物质系统的响应性、自适应性和智能性定义为不同复杂度的信息通道。发现内部复杂度与功能之间存在权衡：增加复杂度会提升潜在信息容量，但也会增加信号衰减和能量耗散，从而存在一个由传输效率、刺激能量和热噪声决定的最优内部复杂度（类似卡诺极限）。；创新点：首次为“响应性”、“自适应性”和“智能性”这三个在软物质领域使用广泛但定义模糊的术语，提供了基于信息通道架构复杂度的严格数学定义。同时，提出了一个统一的、具有维度一致性和热力学耦合的复杂度-功能关系框架，并揭示了合成软物质与生物系统之间性能差距的物理根源（每元素基底能量尺度差异）。
papers.method_zh: 采用信息论作为理论框架。具体包括：将材料系统建模为信息通道（memoryless map、state-conditioned map、feedback-modified channel）；提出了三个信息论度量指标：构型多样性（I1）、Hazen功能选择性（I2）和刺激-响应信息传递率（I3）；并基于这些指标构建了体积信息率（单位体积I3）与功率密度的基准对比平面。

papers.title: Optimal Persistence Reveals Hidden Topology in Complex Energy Landscapes
papers.abstract: Infinite persistence marks the topological transition. For finite persistence, the canyon-finding rate Gamma(tau_p) on the p=2 spherical spin glass forms an inverted-U profile, peaking at an optimal tau_p^*.
